HAD-0890.text: The Qurʾān explains itself mutually; what is unclear to you, seek it in its context.
HAD-0890.narrator: It is transmitted of Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-0890.speaker: He said:

HAD-0891.text: Īmān is not adornment and wish, but what sits firmly in the heart and is confirmed by deeds.
HAD-0891.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-0891.speaker: He said:

HAD-0892.text: This knowledge is religion; so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-0892.narrator: It is transmitted of Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-0892.speaker: He said:

HAD-0893.text: Hold to the traces of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-0893.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-0893.speaker: He said:

HAD-0894.text: The angel is a witness to the Sunnah, and innovation darkens the heart.
HAD-0894.narrator: It is transmitted of Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-0894.speaker: He said:

HAD-0895.text: Nothing will set right the end of this Ummah except that by which its beginning was set right.
HAD-0895.narrator: It is transmitted of Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-0895.speaker: He said:

HAD-0896.text: If the Ḥadīṯ is authentic, then it is my Maḏhab.
HAD-0896.narrator: It is transmitted of aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-0896.speaker: He said:

HAD-0897.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are: holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger ﷺ were.
HAD-0897.narrator: It is transmitted of Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-0897.speaker: He said:

HAD-0898.text: Follow the paths of right guidance, and the small number of those who walk them does not harm you.
HAD-0898.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-0898.speaker: He said:

HAD-0899.text: They used to say: Whoever wants to know should heed the Āṯār.
HAD-0899.narrator: It is transmitted of Ibrāhīm an-Naḫaʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-0899.speaker: He said:

HAD-0900.text: When the death of a man of the Sunnah is reported to me, it is as if I had lost a part of my limbs.
HAD-0900.narrator: It is transmitted of Ayyūb as-Saḫtiyānī رحمه الله:
HAD-0900.speaker: He said:

HAD-0901.text: The Isnad is part of the religion; without the Isnad everyone would say what he wants.
HAD-0901.narrator: It is transmitted of ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-0901.speaker: He said:

HAD-0902.text: We saw the pious in nothing more untruthful than in Ḥadīṯ, when they did not verify.
HAD-0902.narrator: It is transmitted of Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān رحمه الله:
HAD-0902.speaker: He said:

HAD-0903.text: Seek help in memorization by abandoning sins.
HAD-0903.narrator: It is transmitted of Wakīʿ ibn al-Ǧarrāḥ رحمه الله:
HAD-0903.speaker: He said:

HAD-0904.text: Stop where the people before you stopped.
HAD-0904.narrator: It is transmitted of ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله:
HAD-0904.speaker: He said:

HAD-0905.text: The scholar is not the one who knows the good and the bad, but the one who recognizes the good and follows it.
HAD-0905.narrator: It is transmitted of Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah رحمه الله:
HAD-0905.speaker: He said:

HAD-1046.text: Be patient upon the Sunnah and halt where the people before you halted.
HAD-1046.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1046.speaker: He said:

HAD-1047.text: I know of nothing more excellent after prophethood than spreading knowledge.
HAD-1047.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1047.speaker: He said:

HAD-1048.text: All people are, in Fiqh, children of Abū Ḥanīfah.
HAD-1048.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1048.speaker: He said:

HAD-1049.text: Perhaps a small work carries a great intention, and perhaps a bad intention spoils a great deed.
HAD-1049.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1049.speaker: He said:

HAD-1050.text: The believer in this world is like a prisoner who strives for his release.
HAD-1050.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1050.speaker: He said:

HAD-1051.text: Whoever deceives us is not of us.
HAD-1051.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1051.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1052.text: Whoever swears by other than Allah has committed Kufr or Širk.
HAD-1052.narrator: Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1052.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1053.text: There is no obedience in disobedience to Allah; obedience exists only in what is good.
HAD-1053.narrator: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1053.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1054.text: Each of you is a shepherd, and each is responsible for his flock.
HAD-1054.narrator: Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1054.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1055.text: Two gifts are unrecognized by many people: health and free time.
HAD-1055.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1055.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1056.text: Whoever dies while associating nothing with Allah enters Paradise.
HAD-1056.narrator: Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1056.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1057.text: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
HAD-1057.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1057.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1058.text: Every son of Ādam commits faults, and the best of those who err are those who repent.
HAD-1058.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1058.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1059.text: Make use of five before five: your youth before your old age and your health before your illness.
HAD-1059.narrator: Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1059.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1060.text: The likeness of the good companion and the bad companion is like the bearer of musk and the bellows.
HAD-1060.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1060.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1061.text: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not oppress him and does not despise him.
HAD-1061.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1061.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1062.text: It is enough evil for a person to despise his Muslim brother.
HAD-1062.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1062.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1063.text: The likeness of the believers in their love and mercy is like a single body.
HAD-1063.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1063.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1064.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should treat his neighbor well.
HAD-1064.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1064.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1065.narrator: Ǧābir ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1065.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1066.text: Allah loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-1066.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1067.text: Whoever is not merciful will not be shown mercy.
HAD-1067.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1067.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1068.text: None of you should wish for death because of a harm that has befallen him.
HAD-1068.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1068.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1069.text: Whoever among you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand.
HAD-1069.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1069.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1070.text: Guard Allah, and He will guard you.
HAD-1070.narrator: Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1070.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1071.text: Obey me so long as I obey Allah and His Messenger; if I disobey, there is no obedience owed to me.
HAD-1071.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1071.speaker: He said:

HAD-1072.text: We were the lowliest people, then Allah honored us through Islām.
HAD-1072.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1072.speaker: He said:

HAD-1073.text: Learn before you are made leaders.
HAD-1073.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1073.speaker: He said:

HAD-1074.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.
HAD-1074.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1074.speaker: He said:

HAD-1075.text: Speak to people according to what they understand.
HAD-1075.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1075.speaker: He said:

HAD-1076.text: Knowledge calls for action; if it is answered, it remains, otherwise it departs.
HAD-1076.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1076.speaker: He said:

HAD-1077.text: Follow and do not innovate, for you have already been given what suffices.
HAD-1077.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1077.speaker: He said:

HAD-1078.text: How many desire good and do not attain it.
HAD-1078.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1078.speaker: He said:

HAD-1079.text: The Ǧamāʿah is that which accords with the truth, even if you are alone.
HAD-1079.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1079.speaker: He said:

HAD-1080.text: Stones could almost fall from the sky: I tell you that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and you say that Abū Bakr and ʿUmar said.
HAD-1080.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1080.speaker: He said:

HAD-1081.text: The explanation of the Qurʾān consists of what the Arabs know from their language, and of what only Allah knows.
HAD-1081.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1081.speaker: He said:

HAD-1082.text: Every innovation is misguidance, even if people regard it as good.
HAD-1082.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1082.speaker: He said:

HAD-1083.text: Any act of worship that the Companions did not know as worship, do not regard it as worship.
HAD-1083.narrator: It is transmitted from Ḥuḏayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1083.speaker: He said:

HAD-1084.text: The one who possesses knowledge and does not act upon it will be questioned severely on the Day of Resurrection.
HAD-1084.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1084.speaker: He said:

HAD-1085.text: Be a scholar, a learner, or a listener, but do not be the fourth.
HAD-1085.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1085.speaker: He said:

HAD-0766.text: The deed most beloved to Allah is the prayer at its time, then kindness to parents, then Ǧihād in the path of Allah.
HAD-0766.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0766.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ was asked:

HAD-0767.text: The religion is Naṣīḥah — sincere loyalty and counsel for Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims, and their common people.
HAD-0767.narrator: Tamīm ad-Dārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0767.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0768.text: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
HAD-0768.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-0768.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0769.text: None of you believes completely until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
HAD-0769.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0769.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0770.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
HAD-0770.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0770.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0771.text: Obey me so long as I obey Allah and His Messenger; if I disobey Allah and His Messenger, you owe me no obedience.
HAD-0771.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0771.speaker: He said:

HAD-0772.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account, and weigh your deeds before they are weighed for you.
HAD-0772.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0772.speaker: He said:

HAD-0773.text: There is no Islām without Ǧamāʿah, no Ǧamāʿah without leadership, and no leadership without obedience in what is permissible.
HAD-0773.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0773.speaker: He said:

HAD-0774.text: Follow and do not innovate, for you have already been given enough.
HAD-0774.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0774.speaker: He said:

HAD-0775.text: Economy in the Sunnah is better than exertion in innovation.
HAD-0775.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0775.speaker: He said:

HAD-0776.text: Whoever among you wishes to follow, let him follow those who have already died, for the living is not safe from Fitnah.
HAD-0776.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0776.speaker: He said:

HAD-0777.text: Every Bidʿah is misguidance, even if people consider it good.
HAD-0777.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-0777.speaker: He said:

HAD-0778.text: Do not sit with the people of desires, for sitting with them makes the hearts sick.
HAD-0778.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-0778.speaker: He said:

HAD-0779.text: Almost every year brings forth an innovation for the people and lets a Sunnah die, until the innovations live and the Sunan die.
HAD-0779.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-0779.speaker: He said:

HAD-0780.text: A person's worth lies in that in which he is good.
HAD-0780.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0780.speaker: He said:

HAD-0781.text: The truth is not recognized by men; recognize the truth, then you will recognize its people.
HAD-0781.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0781.speaker: He said:

HAD-0782.text: Learn knowledge, for learning it for Allah is fear of Allah, seeking it is worship, and repeating it is Tasbīḥ.
HAD-0782.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0782.speaker: He said:

HAD-0783.text: Beware of the deviation of the wise, the hypocrite's dispute by means of the Qurʾān, and the Dunyā that cuts your necks.
HAD-0783.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0783.speaker: He said:

HAD-0784.text: Among the signs of knowledge is that a person is silent about what he does not know.
HAD-0784.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0784.speaker: He said:

HAD-0785.text: Knowledge comes only through learning, and Ḥilm comes only through training oneself in gentleness.
HAD-0785.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-0785.speaker: He said:

HAD-0806.text: I met more than a thousand scholars; I saw none of them differing in this, that Īmān is statement and deed.
HAD-0806.narrator: It is narrated from al-Buḫārī رحمه الله:
HAD-0806.speaker: He said:

HAD-0807.text: Seek help in memorization by refraining from sins.
HAD-0807.narrator: It is narrated from Wakīʿ ibn al-Ǧarrāḥ رحمه الله:
HAD-0807.speaker: He said:

HAD-0808.text: The Qurʾān shows you your illness and your cure: your illness is sins, and your cure is seeking forgiveness.
HAD-0808.narrator: It is narrated from Qatādah ibn Diʿāmah رحمه الله:
HAD-0808.speaker: He said:

HAD-0809.text: It belongs to the Sunnah to keep away from the people of Bidʿah.
HAD-0809.narrator: It is narrated from Ṭāwūs ibn Kaysān رحمه الله:
HAD-0809.speaker: He said:

HAD-0810.text: No deed is harder for the soul than sincerity, because it finds in it no share for itself.
HAD-0810.narrator: It is narrated from Sahl ibn ʿAbdillāh at-Tustarī رحمه الله:
HAD-0810.speaker: He said:

HAD-0811.text: Whoever shows people no mercy, Allah shows him no mercy.
HAD-0811.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0811.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0812.text: The strong one is not he who wrestles others to the ground; the strong one is he who controls himself in anger.
HAD-0812.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0812.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0813.text: Īmān has over seventy branches, and modesty is a branch of Īmān.
HAD-0813.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0813.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0814.text: The religion is easy, and no one goes to extremes in the religion without it overwhelming him.
HAD-0814.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0814.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0815.text: Make it easy and do not make it hard; give glad tidings and do not frighten away.
HAD-0815.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0815.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0816.text: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-0816.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0817.text: The believer is not stung twice from the same hole.
HAD-0817.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0817.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0818.text: Nothing weighs heavier on the believer's scale on the Day of Resurrection than good character.
HAD-0818.narrator: Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0818.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0819.text: Those dearest to me and seated nearest to me on the Day of Resurrection are those of the best character.
HAD-0819.narrator: Ǧābir ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-0819.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0820.text: Removing harm from the path is a branch of Īmān.
HAD-0820.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0820.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0821.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0821.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0822.text: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the All-Merciful.
HAD-0822.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0822.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0823.text: Whoever says “Subḥānallāhi wa-bi-ḥamdih” a hundred times a day, his sins are forgiven, even if they were like the foam of the sea.
HAD-0823.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0823.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-0824.text: The Sayyid al-Istiġfār is that the servant calls upon his Lord with Tawḥīd, acknowledgment of grace, and a plea for forgiveness.
HAD-0824.narrator: Šaddād ibn Aws رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0824.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ taught:

HAD-0825.text: Allah rejoices more over the repentance of His servant than someone who finds his mount again in the desert.
HAD-0825.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-0825.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1086.text: Learn knowledge, for learning it for the sake of Allah is fear of Him.
HAD-1086.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1086.speaker: He said:

HAD-1087.text: This Qurʾān is for you either a proof or against you.
HAD-1087.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1087.speaker: He said:

HAD-1088.text: Knowledge is abundant, and life is short; take from knowledge what is necessary for your religion.
HAD-1088.narrator: It is transmitted from Salmān al-Fārisī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1088.speaker: He said:

HAD-1089.text: Whoever is silent about the truth is like a mute Šayṭān.
HAD-1089.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1089.speaker: He said:

HAD-1090.text: We pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to speak the truth wherever we are.
HAD-1090.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUbādah ibn aṣ-Ṣāmit رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1090.speaker: He said:

HAD-1091.text: This knowledge is religion, so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1091.narrator: It is transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1091.speaker: He said:

HAD-1092.text: The believer joins good action with fear, and the hypocrite joins bad action with security.
HAD-1092.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1092.speaker: He said:

HAD-1093.text: O son of Ādam, you are only days; when a day passes, a part of you passes.
HAD-1093.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1093.speaker: He said:

HAD-1094.text: From Allah comes the message, upon the Messenger lies the conveyance, and upon us lies submission.
HAD-1094.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Šihāb az-Zuhrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1094.speaker: He said:

HAD-1095.text: Hold to the reports of those before you, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1095.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1095.speaker: He said:

HAD-1096.text: Knowledge is what came from the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ; what goes beyond that is not knowledge.
HAD-1096.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1096.speaker: He said:

HAD-1097.text: Innovation is dearer to Iblīs than sin, for one repents of sin, but of innovation only rarely.
HAD-1097.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1097.speaker: He said:

HAD-1098.text: Follow the paths of guidance, and the small number of followers does not harm you.
HAD-1098.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1098.speaker: He said:

HAD-1099.text: When the death of a man of Ahl as-Sunnah is reported to me, it is as if I had lost a part of my body.
HAD-1099.narrator: It is transmitted from Ayyūb as-Saḫtiyānī رحمه الله:
HAD-1099.speaker: He said:

HAD-1100.text: The end of this Ummah is set right only by that by which its beginning was set right.
HAD-1100.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1100.speaker: He said:

HAD-1101.text: The Sunnah is like the ark of Nūḥ; whoever boards it is saved.
HAD-1101.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1101.speaker: He said:

HAD-1102.text: If the Ḥadīṯ is authentic, then it is my Maḏhab.
HAD-1102.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1102.speaker: He said:

HAD-1103.text: The people are agreed that one to whom the Sunnah of the Messenger ﷺ has become clear is not permitted to leave it because of another’s statement.
HAD-1103.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1103.speaker: He said:

HAD-1104.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger ﷺ were.
HAD-1104.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1104.speaker: He said:

HAD-1105.text: Do not speak in any matter in which you have no Imām before you.
HAD-1105.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1105.speaker: He said:

HAD-1006.text: Defending the Sunnah is better than fighting with the sword.
HAD-1006.narrator: It is transmitted from Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1006.speaker: He said:

HAD-1007.text: Stop where the people stopped, for they stopped upon knowledge.
HAD-1007.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله:
HAD-1007.speaker: He said:

HAD-1008.text: A person remains in good as long as he admonishes himself.
HAD-1008.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1008.speaker: He said:

HAD-1009.text: If a man is told of the Sunnah and he says: Leave us with that, then know that he stands on the brink of destruction.
HAD-1009.narrator: It is transmitted from Ayyūb as-Saḫtiyānī رحمه الله:
HAD-1009.speaker: He said:

HAD-1010.text: Knowledge is what came from the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ; what came after that is not the same knowledge.
HAD-1010.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1010.speaker: He said:

HAD-1011.text: The religion is easy, and no one makes the religion hard except that it overwhelms him.
HAD-1011.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1011.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1012.text: Whoever introduces a good guidance has its reward and the reward of whoever acts upon it afterwards, without their rewards being diminished.
HAD-1012.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1012.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1013.text: Whoever is not merciful is not shown mercy.
HAD-1013.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1013.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1014.text: A Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not oppress him and does not hand him over.
HAD-1014.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1014.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1015.text: Whoever defends the honor of his brother, Allah protects his face from the Fire.
HAD-1015.narrator: Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1015.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1016.text: The Merciful shows mercy to the merciful; be merciful to the inhabitants of the earth.
HAD-1016.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1016.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1017.text: The believer is the mirror of the believer.
HAD-1017.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1017.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1018.text: None of you should wish for death because of a harm that has befallen him.
HAD-1018.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1018.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1019.text: The best gatherings are the most spacious.
HAD-1019.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1019.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1020.text: Paradise is closer to each person than his shoelace, and likewise the Fire.
HAD-1020.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1020.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1021.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
HAD-1021.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1021.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1022.text: When gentleness is in a matter, it beautifies it; and when it is removed, it makes it ugly.
HAD-1022.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1023.text: The world is the prison of the believer and the paradise of the disbeliever.
HAD-1023.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1023.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1024.text: The strong one is he who controls himself when angry.
HAD-1024.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1024.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1025.text: Allah is pleased with the servant when he eats and praises Him for it.
HAD-1025.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1025.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1306.text: Whoever knows people finds rest from them; and whoever knows his Lord is occupied with Him.
HAD-1306.narrator: It is transmitted of Qatādah رحمه الله:
HAD-1306.speaker: He said:

HAD-1307.text: There is no good in one who does not gather knowledge in order to attain Taqwā thereby.
HAD-1307.narrator: It is transmitted of Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib رحمه الله:
HAD-1307.speaker: He said:

HAD-1308.text: Halt where the people halted; for they halted upon knowledge.
HAD-1308.narrator: It is transmitted of ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله:
HAD-1308.speaker: He said:

HAD-1309.text: Islām is the Sunnah, and the Sunnah is Islām.
HAD-1309.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Barbahārī رحمه الله:
HAD-1309.speaker: He said:

HAD-1310.text: Among the words of the Ahl as-Sunnah is that Īmān is statement, deed, and intention.
HAD-1310.narrator: It is transmitted of Ibn Abī Zayd al-Qayrawānī رحمه الله:
HAD-1310.speaker: He said:

HAD-1311.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
HAD-1311.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1311.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1312.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him maintain his ties of kinship.
HAD-1312.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1312.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1313.text: The strong one is not the wrestler, but the one who controls himself in anger.
HAD-1313.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1313.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1314.text: The Merciful has mercy on the merciful.
HAD-1314.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1314.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1315.text: Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah does not show mercy to him.
HAD-1315.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1315.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1316.text: Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
HAD-1316.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1316.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1317.text: Whoever travels the path of knowledge, Allah thereby makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1317.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1317.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1318.text: Whoever covers a Muslim, Allah covers him in this world and in the Hereafter.
HAD-1318.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1318.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1319.text: Whoever grants relief to a debtor, Allah grants him relief in this world and in the Hereafter.
HAD-1319.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1319.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1320.text: The world is the prison of the believer and the paradise of the unbeliever.
HAD-1320.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1320.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1321.text: A believer is not stung twice from the same hole.
HAD-1321.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1321.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1322.text: Make things easy and do not make them hard; give glad tidings and do not frighten away.
HAD-1322.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1322.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1323.text: When gentleness is in a matter, it adorns it; and when it is removed, it makes it ugly.
HAD-1323.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1324.text: Allah is good and accepts only what is good.
HAD-1324.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1324.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1325.text: Allah does not look at your bodies and forms, but at your hearts.
HAD-1325.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1325.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1406.text: Whoever toys with his religion, the Šayṭān toys with his heart.
HAD-1406.narrator: It is transmitted from Ṭāwūs ibn Kaysān رحمه الله:
HAD-1406.speaker: He said:

HAD-1407.text: Whoever exposes his religion to disputes often changes his opinion.
HAD-1407.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله:
HAD-1407.speaker: He said:

HAD-1408.text: Stand where the people stood still; for they stood still out of knowledge.
HAD-1408.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله:
HAD-1408.speaker: He said:

HAD-1409.text: Whoever leaves the trace of the Salaf, the ways of desires are opened to him.
HAD-1409.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Baṭṭah رحمه الله:
HAD-1409.speaker: He said:

HAD-1410.text: Islām is the Sunnah, and the Sunnah is Islām.
HAD-1410.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Barbahārī رحمه الله:
HAD-1410.speaker: He said:

HAD-1411.text: The world is the prison of the believer and the paradise of the disbeliever.
HAD-1411.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1411.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1412.text: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer; and in both there is good.
HAD-1412.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1412.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1413.text: Be keen for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not grow weak.
HAD-1413.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1413.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1414.text: If something befalls you, do not say: If only I had; rather say: Allah has decreed, and what He wills, He does.
HAD-1414.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1414.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1415.text: Whoever strives for chastity, Allah makes him chaste; and whoever seeks contentment, Allah makes him content.
HAD-1415.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1415.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1416.text: No one has been given a gift better and more encompassing than patience.
HAD-1416.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1416.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1417.text: Whoever covers a Muslim, Allah covers him on the Day of Resurrection.
HAD-1417.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1417.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1418.text: Whoever fulfills the needs of his brother, Allah fulfills his needs.
HAD-1418.narrator: Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1418.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1419.text: Whoever relieves a believer of a worry of this world, Allah relieves him of a worry of the Last Day.
HAD-1419.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1419.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1420.text: Whoever grants relief to someone in need, Allah grants him relief in this world and in the Hereafter.
HAD-1420.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1420.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1421.text: Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
HAD-1421.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1421.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1422.text: No people gather in a house of Allah, recite the Book of Allah and learn it together, except that tranquility descends upon them.
HAD-1422.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1422.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1423.text: Whoever is held back by his deed, his lineage does not advance him.
HAD-1423.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1423.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1424.text: For every bone of yours there is a Ṣadaqah in the morning.
HAD-1424.narrator: Abū Dharr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1424.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1425.text: Your smile in the face of your brother is a Ṣadaqah for you.
HAD-1425.narrator: Abū Dharr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1425.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1206.text: Whoever serves Allah without knowledge causes more harm than he benefits.
HAD-1206.narrator: It is transmitted of ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله:
HAD-1206.speaker: He said:

HAD-1207.text: People need knowledge more than food and drink.
HAD-1207.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Layṯ ibn Saʿd رحمه الله:
HAD-1207.speaker: He said:

HAD-1208.text: Everyone may be accepted and rejected, except the dweller of this grave ﷺ.
HAD-1208.narrator: It is transmitted of Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1208.speaker: He said:

HAD-1209.text: Do not marvel at anyone until you see upon what he dies at the end of his life.
HAD-1209.narrator: It is transmitted of Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1209.speaker: He said:

HAD-1210.text: The foundation of the Sunnah is that upon which the Companions of the Messenger ﷺ agreed.
HAD-1210.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Ḥumaydī رحمه الله:
HAD-1210.speaker: He said:

HAD-1211.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
HAD-1211.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1211.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1212.text: The strong person is not the one in wrestling, but whoever controls himself in anger.
HAD-1212.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1212.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1213.text: Truthfulness leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Paradise.
HAD-1213.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1213.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1214.text: Whoever shows a person the way to good receives the reward of the one who does it.
HAD-1214.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1214.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1215.text: Your smile in the face of your brother is a Ṣadaqah for you.
HAD-1215.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1215.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1216.text: Every joint of the human being owes a Ṣadaqah each day.
HAD-1216.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1216.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1217.narrator: Abū Mālik al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1217.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1218.text: Allah does not look at your bodies and forms, but at your hearts and deeds.
HAD-1218.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1218.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1219.text: Whoever is not grateful to people is not grateful to Allah.
HAD-1219.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1219.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1220.text: Allah has prescribed Iḥsān in every matter.
HAD-1220.narrator: Šaddād ibn Aws رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1220.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1221.text: A good word is a Ṣadaqah.
HAD-1221.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1221.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1222.text: Whoever conceals a fault of a Muslim, Allah conceals his fault on the Last Day.
HAD-1222.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1222.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1223.text: Allah has revealed to me that you should be humble, so that no one is arrogant toward another.
HAD-1223.narrator: ʿIyāḍ ibn Ḥimār رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1223.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1224.text: Whoever among you sees something reprehensible, let him change it with his hand.
HAD-1224.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1224.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1225.text: The believer is not stung twice from the same hole.
HAD-1225.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1225.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1246.text: If the Ḥadīṯ is authentic, then that is my school of law.
HAD-1246.narrator: It is transmitted of aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1246.speaker: He said:

HAD-1247.text: The angels are the guardians of the sky, and the people of the Ḥadīṯ are the guardians of the earth.
HAD-1247.narrator: It is transmitted of Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1247.speaker: He said:

HAD-1248.text: How many small deeds are made great by intention, and how many great deeds are made small by intention.
HAD-1248.narrator: It is transmitted of Ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1248.speaker: He said:

HAD-1249.text: Hold to the transmissions of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1249.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1249.speaker: He said:

HAD-1250.text: Follow the paths of right guidance; the small number of their people does not harm you.
HAD-1250.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1250.speaker: He said:

HAD-1251.text: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
HAD-1251.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1251.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1252.text: None of you believes completely until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
HAD-1252.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1252.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1253.narrator: Tamīm ad-Dārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1253.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1254.text: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
HAD-1254.narrator: al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1254.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1255.text: Piety is good character; sin is what grows restless in your breast.
HAD-1255.narrator: an-Nawwās ibn Samʿān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1255.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1256.text: Do not belittle anything of the good, even if you meet your brother with a cheerful face.
HAD-1256.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1256.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1257.text: Whoever points to good has the reward of the one who does it.
HAD-1257.narrator: Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1257.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1258.narrator: Abū Mālik al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1258.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1259.text: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.
HAD-1259.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1259.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1260.narrator: ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1260.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1261.text: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-1261.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1262.text: Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, and be servants of Allah as brothers.
HAD-1262.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1262.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1263.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1263.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1264.text: Your smile in the face of your brother is Ṣadaqah for you.
HAD-1264.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1264.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1265.text: Removing an obstacle from the path is Ṣadaqah.
HAD-1265.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1265.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1266.text: Prayer is light, Ṣadaqah is proof, and patience is radiance.
HAD-1266.narrator: Abū Mālik al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1266.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1267.text: The words most beloved to Allah are four: Subḥānallāh, al-Ḥamdulillāh, lā ilāha illā Allah, and Allahu Akbar.
HAD-1267.narrator: Samurah ibn Ǧundub رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1267.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1268.text: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful.
HAD-1268.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1268.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1269.text: Whoever says one hundred times: Subḥānallāhi wa bi-ḥamdih, his sins are forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
HAD-1269.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1269.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1270.text: Īmān has over seventy branches, and modesty is a branch of Īmān.
HAD-1270.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1270.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1271.text: Whoever knows Allah loves Him; and whoever knows the world renounces its deception.
HAD-1271.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1271.speaker: He said:

HAD-1272.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.
HAD-1272.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1272.speaker: He said:

HAD-1273.text: If your hearts were pure, they would never be sated with the word of Allah.
HAD-1273.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1273.speaker: He said:

HAD-1274.text: The one who knows is better than the one who fasts, the one who prays, and the one who fights, when his knowledge is of benefit.
HAD-1274.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1274.speaker: He said:

HAD-1275.text: Follow and do not invent anew; for you have already been sufficed.
HAD-1275.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1275.speaker: He said:

HAD-1276.text: How many want the good, yet do not attain it.
HAD-1276.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1276.speaker: He said:

HAD-1277.text: Hold to the transmission; for it is a safeguard against misguidance.
HAD-1277.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1277.speaker: He said:

HAD-1278.text: Every innovation is misguidance, even if people consider it good.
HAD-1278.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1278.speaker: He said:

HAD-1279.text: You will not be a scholar until you learn; and you will not be one who knows until you act upon the knowledge.
HAD-1279.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1279.speaker: He said:

HAD-1280.text: Learn knowledge; for learning it is fear of Allah, and seeking it is ʿIbādah.
HAD-1280.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1280.speaker: He said:

HAD-1281.text: Every act of worship that the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ did not perform, do not perform it.
HAD-1281.narrator: It is transmitted from Ḥuḏayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1281.speaker: He said:

HAD-1282.text: The likeness of the believer is that of a plant which the wind bends but does not break.
HAD-1282.narrator: It is transmitted from Salman al-Fārisī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1282.speaker: He said:

HAD-1283.text: The heart is a king, and the limbs are its soldiers.
HAD-1283.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1283.speaker: He said:

HAD-1284.text: The first trial of this Ummah after its Prophet was satiety.
HAD-1284.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿĀʾišah رضي الله عنها:
HAD-1284.speaker: She said:

HAD-1285.text: Whoever is silent is saved; and whoever speaks should say what is good.
HAD-1285.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1285.speaker: He said:

HAD-1286.text: The likeness of the heart is like a feather in the desert that the wind turns.
HAD-1286.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1286.speaker: He said:

HAD-1287.text: Whoever meets Allah without having associated anything with Him has the basis of salvation.
HAD-1287.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUbādah ibn aṣ-Ṣāmit رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1287.speaker: He said:

HAD-1288.text: Knowledge is not through many reports, but through understanding and fear of Allah.
HAD-1288.narrator: It is transmitted from Zayd ibn Ṯābit رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1288.speaker: He said:

HAD-1289.text: Indeed, poverty is dearer to me than wealth that distracts me.
HAD-1289.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1289.speaker: He said:

HAD-1290.text: The believer sees his sins as though he were sitting under a mountain that could fall upon him.
HAD-1290.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1290.speaker: He said:

HAD-1291.text: This knowledge is religion, so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1291.narrator: It is transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1291.speaker: He said:

HAD-1292.text: The believer combines Iḥsān and fear; the hypocrite combines negligence and security.
HAD-1292.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1292.speaker: He said:

HAD-1293.text: The angels are guardians of heaven, and the people of Ḥadīṯ are guardians of the earth.
HAD-1293.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1293.speaker: He said:

HAD-1294.text: The Sunnah is like the ark of Nūḥ: whoever boards it is saved.
HAD-1294.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1294.speaker: He said:

HAD-1295.text: Hold to the transmissions of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1295.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1295.speaker: He said:

HAD-1296.text: The Isnād belongs to the religion; were it not for the Isnād, everyone would say what he wishes.
HAD-1296.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1296.speaker: He said:

HAD-1297.text: Whoever shows inclination to the people of Bidʿah has thereby helped to destroy Islām.
HAD-1297.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1297.speaker: He said:

HAD-1298.text: They detested lingering over desires and innovations.
HAD-1298.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibrāhīm an-Naḫaʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1298.speaker: He said:

HAD-1299.text: The more strongly a man loves the Sunnah, the more he avoids the people of Bidʿah.
HAD-1299.narrator: It is transmitted from Ayyūb as-Saḫtiyānī رحمه الله:
HAD-1299.speaker: He said:

HAD-1300.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are: holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger ﷺ were.
HAD-1300.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1300.speaker: He said:

HAD-1301.text: All Muslims agree: one to whom a Sunnah of the Messenger ﷺ becomes clear is not permitted to abandon it because of another’s statement.
HAD-1301.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1301.speaker: He said:

HAD-1302.text: Whoever seeks the Ḥadīṯ seeks the highest of the matter.
HAD-1302.narrator: It is transmitted from Wakīʿ ibn al-Ǧarrāḥ رحمه الله:
HAD-1302.speaker: He said:

HAD-1303.text: Defending the Sunnah is better than fighting with the sword.
HAD-1303.narrator: It is transmitted from Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1303.speaker: He said:

HAD-1304.text: One does not become an Imām until one distinguishes between authentic and weak Ḥadīṯ.
HAD-1304.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī رحمه الله:
HAD-1304.speaker: He said:

HAD-1305.text: The Sunnah is that a person gives himself over to what came from Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.
HAD-1305.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥumaydī رحمه الله:
HAD-1305.speaker: He said:

HAD-1426.text: Your enjoining of good and forbidding of the reprehensible is a Ṣadaqah for you.
HAD-1426.narrator: Abū Dharr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1426.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1427.text: Your help to a man on his mount is a Ṣadaqah for you.
HAD-1427.narrator: Abū Dharr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1427.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1428.text: Every good deed is a Ṣadaqah.
HAD-1428.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1428.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1429.text: The most complete of the believers in Īmān are those with the best character.
HAD-1429.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1429.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1430.text: The best of you is the one who has the best character.
HAD-1430.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1430.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1431.text: Whoever asks Allah, He gives him; and whoever seeks refuge with Him, He grants him refuge.
HAD-1431.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1431.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1432.text: The Merciful is merciful to those who are merciful.
HAD-1432.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1432.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1433.text: Be merciful to those on the earth, then the One in heaven will be merciful to you.
HAD-1433.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1433.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1434.text: Whoever is not grateful to people is not grateful to Allah.
HAD-1434.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1434.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1435.text: The one who looks after the widow and the needy is like the fighter on the path of Allah.
HAD-1435.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1435.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1436.text: I and the one who cares for an orphan are so close in Paradise.
HAD-1436.narrator: Sahl ibn Saʿd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1436.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1437.text: Whoever turns back before the sun rises from the west, Allah accepts his repentance.
HAD-1437.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1437.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1438.text: Allah rejoices more over the repentance of His servant than one of you over his lost mount.
HAD-1438.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1438.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1439.text: Allah extends His hand in the night so that the sinner of the day may repent.
HAD-1439.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1439.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1440.text: Allah extends His hand by day so that the sinner of the night may repent.
HAD-1440.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1440.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1441.text: Sit with the repentant, for they have the softest hearts.
HAD-1441.narrator: It is transmitted of ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1441.speaker: He said:

HAD-1442.text: The fortunate one is he who takes a lesson from the condition of others.
HAD-1442.narrator: It is transmitted of Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1442.speaker: He said:

HAD-1443.text: A good deed brings light in the heart, brightness in the face, and strength in the body.
HAD-1443.narrator: It is transmitted of Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1443.speaker: He said:

HAD-1444.text: A sin brings darkness in the heart, gloom in the face, and weakness in the body.
HAD-1444.narrator: It is transmitted of Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1444.speaker: He said:

HAD-1445.text: The Dunyā is only a dream, and the Hereafter is the awakening.
HAD-1445.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1445.speaker: He said:

HAD-1446.text: Whoever knows himself occupies himself with the improvement of his soul.
HAD-1446.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1446.speaker: He said:

HAD-1447.text: Whoever knows Allah knows the insignificance of the world.
HAD-1447.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah رحمه الله:
HAD-1447.speaker: He said:

HAD-1448.text: Whoever wants the Hereafter must be sincere in knowledge.
HAD-1448.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1448.speaker: He said:

HAD-1449.text: People need knowledge more than food and drink.
HAD-1449.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1449.speaker: He said:

HAD-1450.text: Perhaps a small deed grows through the intention, and perhaps a great deed becomes small through the intention.
HAD-1450.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1450.speaker: He said:

HAD-1451.text: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not wrong him and does not hand him over.
HAD-1451.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1451.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1452.text: Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah.
HAD-1452.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1452.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1453.text: None of you believes completely until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
HAD-1453.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1453.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1454.text: The believer is to the believer like a building; one part strengthens the other.
HAD-1454.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1454.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1455.text: The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks, he lies; when he promises, he breaks his promise; and when something is entrusted to him, he betrays.
HAD-1455.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1455.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1456.text: The best of you is the one who learns the Qurʾān and teaches it.
HAD-1456.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1456.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1457.text: Whoever travels a path on which he seeks knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1457.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1457.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1458.text: The world is the prison of the believer and the paradise of the unbeliever.
HAD-1458.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1458.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1459.text: Whoever among you sees something reprehensible, let him change it with his hand.
HAD-1459.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1459.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1460.text: Allah is good and accepts only what is good.
HAD-1460.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1460.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1461.text: Strength is not by throwing someone down, but strength is mastering oneself in anger.
HAD-1461.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1461.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1462.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1462.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1463.text: Fear Allah wherever you are, and let a good deed that wipes it out follow the bad deed.
HAD-1463.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1463.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1464.text: Truthfulness leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Paradise.
HAD-1464.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1464.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1465.text: Make things easy and do not make them hard; give glad tidings and do not drive away.
HAD-1465.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1465.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1466.text: The Merciful has mercy on the merciful.
HAD-1466.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1466.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1467.text: Whoever owes his brother honor, property, or anything else, let him have himself cleared of it today.
HAD-1467.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1467.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1468.text: Beware of envy, for envy consumes good deeds as fire consumes wood.
HAD-1468.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1468.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1469.text: The deeds most beloved to Allah are the constant ones, even if they are few.
HAD-1469.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1470.text: Whoever loves Allah and meeting Him, Allah’s meeting loves him.
HAD-1470.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1470.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1471.text: Truthfulness is Amānah, and lying is betrayal.
HAD-1471.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1471.speaker: He said:

HAD-1472.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.
HAD-1472.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1472.speaker: He said:

HAD-1473.text: If your hearts were pure, you would not grow sated with the word of your Lord.
HAD-1473.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1473.speaker: He said:

HAD-1474.text: Knowledge calls to action; if action answers, it remains, otherwise it goes.
HAD-1474.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1474.speaker: He said:

HAD-1475.text: Follow and do not invent anew; you have already been given enough.
HAD-1475.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1475.speaker: He said:

HAD-1476.text: The bearer of Takwā is the one who guards himself from Allah’s punishment.
HAD-1476.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1476.speaker: He said:

HAD-1477.text: Among the signs of the knowledgeable is that he learns what he does not know.
HAD-1477.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1477.speaker: He said:

HAD-1478.text: Learn knowledge, for learning it for Allah’s sake is the fear of Allah.
HAD-1478.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1478.speaker: He said:

HAD-1479.text: The people used to ask about the good, and I asked about the evil, out of fear that it would befall me.
HAD-1479.narrator: It is transmitted from Ḥuḏayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1479.speaker: He said:

HAD-1480.text: The likeness of the heart and the body is like a king and an army.
HAD-1480.narrator: It is transmitted from Salmān al-Fārisī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1480.speaker: He said:

HAD-1481.text: When you are in the evening, do not expect the morning; and when you are in the morning, do not expect the evening.
HAD-1481.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1481.speaker: He said:

HAD-1482.text: The first thing that came down of the Qurʾān was sūras about Paradise and Hell.
HAD-1482.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿĀʾišah رضي الله عنها:
HAD-1482.speaker: She said:

HAD-1483.text: The heart is the king, and the limbs are its soldiers.
HAD-1483.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1483.speaker: He said:

HAD-1484.text: The Qurʾān is for you either a reward or a proof against you.
HAD-1484.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1484.speaker: He said:

HAD-1485.text: The believer sees his sins as though he were sitting beneath a mountain.
HAD-1485.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1485.speaker: He said:

HAD-1326.text: Truthfulness leads to piety, and piety leads to Paradise.
HAD-1326.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1326.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1327.text: Lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire.
HAD-1327.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1327.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1328.text: The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks, he lies; when he promises, he breaks his promise; when he is entrusted, he betrays.
HAD-1328.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1328.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1329.text: A sign of the beauty of a person’s Islam is that he leaves what does not concern him.
HAD-1329.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1329.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1330.text: Whoever takes the path of knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1330.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1330.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1331.text: The best of you is the best to his family, and I am the best of you to his family.
HAD-1331.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1332.text: The best of you is the one who learns the Qurʾān and teaches it.
HAD-1332.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1332.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1333.text: Read the Qurʾān, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.
HAD-1333.narrator: Abū Umāmah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1333.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1334.text: Allah has among the people His people: the people of the Qurʾān.
HAD-1334.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1334.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1335.text: The knowledgeable reciter of the Qurʾān is with the noble and obedient scribes.
HAD-1335.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1336.text: Whoever fasts Ramaḍān out of Īmān and in hope of reward, what preceded of his sins is forgiven him.
HAD-1336.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1336.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1337.text: Whoever stands in prayer in Ramaḍān out of Īmān and in hope of reward, what preceded of his sins is forgiven him.
HAD-1337.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1337.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1338.text: Whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr out of Īmān and in hope of reward, what preceded of his sins is forgiven him.
HAD-1338.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1338.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1339.text: Between a person and Širk as well as Kufr stands the abandonment of the prayer.
HAD-1339.narrator: Ǧābir ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1339.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1340.text: The covenant between us and them is the prayer; whoever abandons it has committed Kufr.
HAD-1340.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1341.text: Whoever wishes to take a model, let him take as a model those who have already died: the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ, the best of this Ummah.
HAD-1341.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1341.speaker: He said:

HAD-1342.text: Soon stones will fall upon you from the sky: I tell you: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and you say: Abū Bakr and ʿUmar said.
HAD-1342.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1342.speaker: He said:

HAD-1343.text: From everyone is taken and rejected, except from the occupant of this grave.
HAD-1343.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1343.speaker: He said:

HAD-1344.text: The people of the Sunnah were always the fewest among the people.
HAD-1344.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1344.speaker: He said:

HAD-1345.text: Treat the people of the Sunnah well, for they are strangers.
HAD-1345.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1345.speaker: He said:

HAD-1346.text: Be patient upon the Sunnah and stop where the people stopped.
HAD-1346.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1346.speaker: He said:

HAD-1347.text: Whoever belittles the people of the Sunnah, his religion is in danger.
HAD-1347.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1347.speaker: He said:

HAD-1348.text: Do not speak about any matter in which you have no Imām before you.
HAD-1348.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1348.speaker: He said:

HAD-1349.text: Know that the religion is known only through transmission and not through opinions.
HAD-1349.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Barbahārī رحمه الله:
HAD-1349.speaker: He said:

HAD-1350.text: Whoever leaves the trace of the Salaf, the paths of desires are opened to him.
HAD-1350.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Baṭṭah رحمه الله:
HAD-1350.speaker: He said:

HAD-1351.text: Look at the one who is below you, and do not look at the one who is above you; that is more fitting, so that you do not belittle the favor of Allah.
HAD-1351.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1351.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1352.text: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim: he does not oppress him and does not abandon him.
HAD-1352.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1352.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1353.text: The believer to the believer is like a building; one part strengthens the other.
HAD-1353.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1353.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1354.text: The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks, he lies; when he promises, he breaks it; and when he is entrusted, he betrays.
HAD-1354.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1354.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1355.text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
HAD-1355.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1355.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1356.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should treat his neighbor well.
HAD-1356.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1356.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1357.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honor his guest.
HAD-1357.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1357.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1358.text: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-1358.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1359.text: Whoever is not merciful to people, Allah is not merciful to him.
HAD-1359.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1359.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1360.text: A good word is a Ṣadaqah.
HAD-1360.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1360.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1361.text: Protect yourselves from the Fire, even if only with half a date.
HAD-1361.narrator: ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1361.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1362.text: Between the five prayers, from Friday to Friday, and from Ramaḍān to Ramaḍān, there is expiation for what lies between them, so long as the major sins are avoided.
HAD-1362.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1362.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1363.text: Whoever completes the Wuḍūʾ, his sins leave his body.
HAD-1363.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1363.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1364.text: Shall I not direct you to something by which Allah erases faults and raises ranks?
HAD-1364.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1364.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1365.text: Frequent walking to the mosques and waiting for the prayer after the prayer is Ribāṭ.
HAD-1365.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1365.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1126.text: Whoever covers a Muslim, Allah covers him in this world and in the Hereafter.
HAD-1126.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1126.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1127.text: The believer is to the believer like a building whose parts support one another.
HAD-1127.narrator: Abū Mūsā رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1127.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1128.text: The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.
HAD-1128.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1128.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1129.text: The Merciful shows mercy to the merciful.
HAD-1129.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1129.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1130.text: Whoever lies in order to make people laugh, woe to him, woe to him.
HAD-1130.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1130.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1131.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his neighbor.
HAD-1131.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1131.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1132.text: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not oppress him and does not abandon him.
HAD-1132.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1132.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1133.text: Make things easy and do not make them hard; give glad tidings and do not frighten away.
HAD-1133.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1133.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1134.text: The believer to the believer is like a building; one part strengthens the other.
HAD-1134.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1134.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1135.text: Whoever removes from a believer a worry of this world, Allah removes from him a worry of the Day of Resurrection.
HAD-1135.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1135.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1136.text: Whoever walks a path on which he seeks knowledge, Allah thereby makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1136.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1136.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1137.text: Truthfulness leads to piety, and piety leads to Paradise.
HAD-1137.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1137.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1138.text: A strong sign of the goodness of a person’s Islam is that he leaves what does not concern him.
HAD-1138.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1138.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1139.text: The lawful is clear and the forbidden is clear, and between them lie doubtful things.
HAD-1139.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1139.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1140.text: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
HAD-1140.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1140.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1141.text: Hold yourselves to account before you are held to account.
HAD-1141.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1141.speaker: He said:

HAD-1142.text: Follow and do not innovate; for you have already been given what suffices.
HAD-1142.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1142.speaker: He said:

HAD-1143.text: A stone from the sky almost strikes you: I say, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and you say: Abū Bakr and ʿUmar said.
HAD-1143.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1143.speaker: He said:

HAD-1144.text: Every innovation is misguidance, even if people regard it as good.
HAD-1144.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1144.speaker: He said:

HAD-1145.text: The Sunnah is heavy for the one who follows his desires.
HAD-1145.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1145.speaker: He said:

HAD-1146.text: This knowledge is religion; so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1146.narrator: It is transmitted of Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1146.speaker: He said:

HAD-1147.text: The Sunnah is like the ark of Nūḥ: whoever boards it is saved.
HAD-1147.narrator: It is transmitted of Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1147.speaker: He said:

HAD-1148.text: Hold fast to the Āṯār of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1148.narrator: It is transmitted of al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1148.speaker: He said:

HAD-1149.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are: holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were.
HAD-1149.narrator: It is transmitted of Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1149.speaker: He said:

HAD-1150.text: If the Ḥadīṯ is authentic, then that is my Maḏhab.
HAD-1150.narrator: It is transmitted of aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1150.speaker: He said:

HAD-1151.text: Whoever removes from a believer one worry among the worries of this world, Allah removes from him one worry among the worries of the Last Day.
HAD-1151.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1151.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1152.text: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
HAD-1152.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1152.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1153.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his neighbor.
HAD-1153.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1153.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1154.text: Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
HAD-1154.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1154.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1155.text: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-1155.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1156.text: Fear Allah wherever you are, and let a good deed follow the bad deed, one that erases it.
HAD-1156.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1156.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1157.text: Among the signs of a person’s good Islām is that he leaves what does not concern him.
HAD-1157.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1157.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1158.text: The lawful is clear, the forbidden is clear, and between them lie doubtful things.
HAD-1158.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1158.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1159.text: The believer is to the believer like a building; one part strengthens the other.
HAD-1159.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1159.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1160.text: Whoever does not show mercy to people, to him mercy is not shown.
HAD-1160.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1160.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1161.text: Whoever goes on a path on which he seeks knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1161.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1161.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1162.text: The strong one is not the one who throws others down, but the one who controls himself in anger.
HAD-1162.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1162.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1163.text: The best charity is that which is given while one possesses enough.
HAD-1163.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1163.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1164.text: The best of you is the one who learns the Qurʾān and teaches it.
HAD-1164.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1164.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1165.text: Truthfulness leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Paradise.
HAD-1165.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1165.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1186.text: The truth is heavy, but its end is praiseworthy.
HAD-1186.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1186.speaker: He said:

HAD-1187.text: Obey me as long as I obey Allah and His Messenger.
HAD-1187.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1187.speaker: He said:

HAD-1188.text: The world is passing away, and the Hereafter is drawing near; be children of the Hereafter.
HAD-1188.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1188.speaker: He said:

HAD-1189.text: The sign of the learned one is that he fears Allah the most.
HAD-1189.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1189.speaker: He said:

HAD-1190.text: The Faqīh is the one who does not make people despair of Allah’s mercy.
HAD-1190.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1190.speaker: He said:

HAD-1191.text: The believer joins Iḥsān with fear, and the hypocrite joins a bad deed with security.
HAD-1191.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1191.speaker: He said:

HAD-1192.text: This knowledge is religion; so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1192.narrator: It is transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1192.speaker: He said:

HAD-1193.text: Knowledge is sought only so that Allah may be feared through it.
HAD-1193.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1193.speaker: He said:

HAD-1194.text: The end of this Ummah is improved only by that through which its beginning was improved.
HAD-1194.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1194.speaker: He said:

HAD-1195.text: Hold to the traces of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1195.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1195.speaker: He said:

HAD-1196.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger ﷺ were.
HAD-1196.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1196.speaker: He said:

HAD-1197.text: A deed is not accepted until it is sincere and correct.
HAD-1197.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1197.speaker: He said:

HAD-1198.text: The Isnād chain belongs to the religion; without the Isnād, anyone could say what he wished.
HAD-1198.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1198.speaker: He said:

HAD-1199.text: Help in memorizing is sought by abandoning sins.
HAD-1199.narrator: It is transmitted from Wakīʿ ibn al-Ǧarrāḥ رحمه الله:
HAD-1199.speaker: He said:

HAD-1200.text: Knowledge was formerly in the breasts of men; then it was transferred into books.
HAD-1200.narrator: It is transmitted from az-Zuhrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1200.speaker: He said:

HAD-1201.text: They used to learn knowledge in order to act upon it.
HAD-1201.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibrāhīm an-Naḫaʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1201.speaker: He said:

HAD-1202.text: Whoever seeks knowledge needs humility and patience.
HAD-1202.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah رحمه الله:
HAD-1202.speaker: He said:

HAD-1203.text: Islām is the Sunnah, and the Sunnah is Islām.
HAD-1203.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Barbahārī رحمه الله:
HAD-1203.speaker: He said:

HAD-1204.text: Hold fast to the transmission and the Sunnah, for I fear that a time of innovation will soon come.
HAD-1204.narrator: It is transmitted from Sahl ibn ʿAbdillāh at-Tustarī رحمه الله:
HAD-1204.speaker: He said:

HAD-1205.text: Do not look at a man’s appearance, but look at his truthfulness in the Ḥadīṯ.
HAD-1205.narrator: It is transmitted from Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān رحمه الله:
HAD-1205.speaker: He said:

HAD-1366.text: Whoever has even a speck of pride in his heart does not enter Paradise.
HAD-1366.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1366.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1367.text: Wealth does not consist in the abundance of possessions; rather, wealth is the contentment of the soul.
HAD-1367.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1367.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1368.text: Make things easy and do not make them hard; give glad tidings and do not drive people away.
HAD-1368.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1368.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1369.text: Allah loves that when one of you performs a deed, he performs it with care.
HAD-1369.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1370.text: Whoever travels a path on which he seeks knowledge, Allah thereby makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1370.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1370.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1371.text: Whoever obeys Allah protects himself, and whoever disobeys Allah harms only his own soul.
HAD-1371.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1371.speaker: He said:

HAD-1372.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.
HAD-1372.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1372.speaker: He said:

HAD-1373.text: If your hearts were pure, they would never be sated with the word of Allah.
HAD-1373.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1373.speaker: He said:

HAD-1374.text: The world is departing and the Hereafter is drawing near; be children of the Hereafter, not children of the world.
HAD-1374.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1374.speaker: He said:

HAD-1375.text: Follow and do not innovate, for you have already been given what suffices.
