HAD-1375.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1375.speaker: He said:

HAD-1376.text: The believer sees his sins as though he were sitting beneath a mountain that threatens to fall upon him.
HAD-1376.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1376.speaker: He said:

HAD-1377.text: A person benefits from the prayer only by that part of it which he performs with attention.
HAD-1377.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1377.speaker: He said:

HAD-1378.text: Allah guarantees to the one who recites the Qurʾān and acts upon it that he will not go astray and will not be wretched.
HAD-1378.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1378.speaker: He said:

HAD-1379.text: Among the signs of the scholar is that he remains silent about what he does not know.
HAD-1379.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1379.speaker: He said:

HAD-1380.text: It is sin enough for a person that he constantly speaks about everything he hears.
HAD-1380.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1380.speaker: He said:

HAD-1381.text: Learn knowledge, for learning it for the sake of Allah is the fear of Allah.
HAD-1381.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1381.speaker: He said:

HAD-1382.text: The Qurʾān is the healing of hearts and the source of guidance.
HAD-1382.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1382.speaker: He said:

HAD-1383.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1383.speaker: He said:

HAD-1384.text: The prayer is a measure: whoever gives in full is given in full.
HAD-1384.narrator: It is transmitted from Salman al-Fārisī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1384.speaker: He said:

HAD-1385.text: The people asked about the good; I asked about the evil, for fear that it would reach me.
HAD-1385.narrator: It is transmitted from Ḥudhayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1385.speaker: He said:

HAD-1486.text: We are a people whom Allah has honored through Islam.
HAD-1486.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1486.speaker: He said:

HAD-1487.text: The worth of every person lies in what he does well.
HAD-1487.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1487.speaker: He said:

HAD-1488.text: The strongest among you is weak in my sight until I take the right from him.
HAD-1488.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1488.speaker: He said:

HAD-1489.text: He who goes astray after right guidance has become clear to him has no excuse.
HAD-1489.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1489.speaker: He said:

HAD-1490.text: Allah preserves peoples through knowledge and makes them leaders of right guidance.
HAD-1490.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1490.speaker: He said:

HAD-1491.text: The believer acts in obedience and is nonetheless fearful; the hypocrite sins and feels secure.
HAD-1491.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1491.speaker: He said:

HAD-1492.text: This knowledge is religion; so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1492.narrator: It is transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1492.speaker: He said:

HAD-1493.text: Nothing is harder for me to deal with than my intention.
HAD-1493.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1493.speaker: He said:

HAD-1494.text: Hold to the Āṯār of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1494.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1494.speaker: He said:

HAD-1495.text: The Sunnah is like the ark of Nūḥ; whoever boards it is saved.
HAD-1495.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1495.speaker: He said:

HAD-1496.text: The foundation of the Sunnah with us is holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were.
HAD-1496.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1496.speaker: He said:

HAD-1497.text: Whoever shows love to an innovator, Allah has corrupted his deed.
HAD-1497.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1497.speaker: He said:

HAD-1498.text: The Isnāds belong to the religion; without Isnāds everyone would say what he wants.
HAD-1498.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1498.speaker: He said:

HAD-1499.text: Seek help in memorization by leaving off sins.
HAD-1499.narrator: It is transmitted from Wakīʿ ibn al-Ǧarrāḥ رحمه الله:
HAD-1499.speaker: He said:

HAD-1500.text: Whoever wants Allah to open his heart for him should often be in solitude and eat little.
HAD-1500.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1500.speaker: He said:

HAD-1501.text: They used to hate that a man shows himself off in religion.
HAD-1501.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibrāhīm an-Naḫaʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1501.speaker: He said:

HAD-1502.text: Perhaps a small deed is great through the intention, and a great deed is small through the intention.
HAD-1502.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1502.speaker: He said:

HAD-1503.text: Salvation lies in holding fast to the Sunnah and in eating what is lawful.
HAD-1503.narrator: It is transmitted from Sahl ibn ʿAbdillāh at-Tustarī رحمه الله:
HAD-1503.speaker: He said:

HAD-1504.text: I saw nothing stranger than one who knows the Sunnah and then leaves it.
HAD-1504.narrator: It is transmitted from Yūnus ibn ʿUbayd رحمه الله:
HAD-1504.speaker: He said:

HAD-1505.text: Whoever acts without knowledge ruins more than he sets right.
HAD-1505.narrator: It is transmitted from Qatādah رحمه الله:
HAD-1505.speaker: He said:

HAD-1506.text: O son of Ādam, you are only days; when a day passes, a part of you passes.
HAD-1506.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1506.speaker: He said:

HAD-1507.text: When something of the Sunnah is reported to a man and he says: Leave us from that, then know that he is upon misguidance.
HAD-1507.narrator: It is transmitted from Ayyūb as-Saḫtiyānī رحمه الله:
HAD-1507.speaker: He said:

HAD-1508.text: The people of the Sunnah were the strangers in every age.
HAD-1508.narrator: It is transmitted from Maʿmar ibn Rāšid رحمه الله:
HAD-1508.speaker: He said:

HAD-1509.text: The people of innovations resemble the hypocrites.
HAD-1509.narrator: It is transmitted from Ḥammād ibn Zayd رحمه الله:
HAD-1509.speaker: He said:

HAD-1510.text: Do not sit with the people of desires, for I am not secure that they will not draw you into their misguidance.
HAD-1510.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Qilābah رحمه الله:
HAD-1510.speaker: He said:

HAD-1511.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
HAD-1511.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1511.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1512.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not harm his neighbor.
HAD-1512.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1512.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1513.text: Help your brother, whether he does wrong or is wronged.
HAD-1513.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1513.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1514.text: The religion is easy, and no one goes to excess in the religion except that it overwhelms him.
HAD-1514.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1514.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1515.text: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the constant ones, even if they are few.
HAD-1515.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1516.text: A man is upon the religion of his close friend, so let everyone look at whom he takes as a friend.
HAD-1516.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1516.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1517.text: Among the major sins is that a person reviles his parents.
HAD-1517.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1517.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1518.text: The world is sweet and green, and Allah makes you successors in it in order to see how you act.
HAD-1518.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1518.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1519.text: Whoever removes a worry from a Muslim, Allah removes from him a worry on the Day of Resurrection.
HAD-1519.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1519.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1520.text: Paradise is closer to you than your shoe straps, and likewise Hell.
HAD-1520.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1520.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1521.text: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the All-Merciful.
HAD-1521.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1521.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1522.text: Allah rejoices more over the repentance of His servant than one of you over his lost mount.
HAD-1522.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1522.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1523.text: Every community has a trial, and the trial of my community is wealth.
HAD-1523.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1523.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1524.text: Deeds are only according to the intentions.
HAD-1524.narrator: ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1524.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1525.text: The strong believer is more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in both there is good.
HAD-1525.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1525.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1166.text: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most lying speech.
HAD-1166.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1166.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1167.text: Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for his flock.
HAD-1167.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1167.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1168.text: None of you believes completely until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
HAD-1168.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1168.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1169.text: The angels surround those who remember Allah, and mercy covers them.
HAD-1169.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1169.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1170.narrator: Tamīm ad-Dārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1170.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1171.text: No servant commits a sin and then performs the purification and asks Allah for forgiveness, except that Allah forgives him.
HAD-1171.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1171.speaker: He said:

HAD-1172.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.
HAD-1172.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1172.speaker: He said:

HAD-1173.text: Knowledge calls for the deed; if the deed answers it, it remains, otherwise it goes.
HAD-1173.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1173.speaker: He said:

HAD-1174.text: Follow and do not invent anew; for you have already been given what suffices.
HAD-1174.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1174.speaker: He said:

HAD-1175.text: Be Rabbānīyīn: wise ones, scholars, and patient ones.
HAD-1175.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1175.speaker: He said:

HAD-1176.text: Be a scholar, a learner, a listener, or one who loves; and do not be the fifth.
HAD-1176.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1176.speaker: He said:

HAD-1177.text: Learn knowledge, for learning it for the sake of Allah is fear of Him.
HAD-1177.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1177.speaker: He said:

HAD-1178.text: If your hearts were pure, they would never be sated with the word of Allah.
HAD-1178.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1178.speaker: He said:

HAD-1179.text: Hearts are vessels; fill them with the Qurʾān and not with anything else.
HAD-1179.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1179.speaker: He said:

HAD-1180.text: Hold fast to the Sunnah, for it is for you the safest path.
HAD-1180.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1180.speaker: He said:

HAD-1181.text: The worth of every person lies in what he does well.
HAD-1181.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1181.speaker: He said:

HAD-1182.text: Whoever tells you that Muḥammad ﷺ concealed something of the revelation has lied.
HAD-1182.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿĀʾišah رضي الله عنها:
HAD-1182.speaker: She said:

HAD-1183.text: When you reach the evening, do not expect the morning; and when you reach the morning, do not expect the evening.
HAD-1183.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1183.speaker: He said:

HAD-1184.text: I have preserved from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ two vessels of knowledge; one of them I have spread.
HAD-1184.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1184.speaker: He said:

HAD-1185.text: How many want good, but do not attain it.
HAD-1185.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1185.speaker: He said:

HAD-1386.text: The first thing that is lifted from this Ummah is humility.
HAD-1386.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿĀʾišah رضي الله عنها:
HAD-1386.speaker: She said:

HAD-1387.text: Indeed, the Qurʾān was sent down so that it would be acted upon.
HAD-1387.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿĀʾišah رضي الله عنها:
HAD-1387.speaker: She said:

HAD-1388.text: A heart that knows Allah loves solitude with Him.
HAD-1388.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1388.speaker: He said:

HAD-1389.text: The heart is the king of the limbs; when the king is good, his soldiers become good.
HAD-1389.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1389.speaker: He said:

HAD-1390.text: The community is what accords with the truth, even if you are alone.
HAD-1390.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1390.speaker: He said:

HAD-1391.text: O son of Ādam, you are only days; when a day passes, a part of you passes.
HAD-1391.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1391.speaker: He said:

HAD-1392.text: The believer remains a guardian over himself and holds himself to account.
HAD-1392.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1392.speaker: He said:

HAD-1393.text: This knowledge is religion; so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1393.narrator: It is transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1393.speaker: He said:

HAD-1394.text: The Sunnah, with us, is holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were.
HAD-1394.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1394.speaker: He said:

HAD-1395.text: Hold fast to the transmissions of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1395.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1395.speaker: He said:

HAD-1396.text: Nothing will improve the end of this Ummah except that which improved its beginning.
HAD-1396.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1396.speaker: He said:

HAD-1397.text: Everyone is taken from his word and rejected, except the occupant of this grave.
HAD-1397.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1397.speaker: He said:

HAD-1398.text: When the Ḥadīṯ is authentic, that is my school of law.
HAD-1398.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1398.speaker: He said:

HAD-1399.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were.
HAD-1399.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1399.speaker: He said:

HAD-1400.text: Beware of speaking about matters in which you have no Imām.
HAD-1400.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1400.speaker: He said:

HAD-1401.text: The Isnād belongs to the religion; were it not for the Isnād, everyone would say what he wants.
HAD-1401.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1401.speaker: He said:

HAD-1402.text: I know of no rank after prophethood that is better than the spreading of knowledge.
HAD-1402.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1402.speaker: He said:

HAD-1403.text: Follow the paths of right guidance; the small number of their people will not harm you.
HAD-1403.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1403.speaker: He said:

HAD-1404.text: Whoever loves a person of innovation, Allah nullifies his deed.
HAD-1404.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1404.speaker: He said:

HAD-1405.text: They used to hate giving a man everything he desires.
HAD-1405.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibrāhīm an-Naḫaʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1405.speaker: He said:

HAD-1226.text: Make things easy and do not make them hard; bring glad tidings and do not drive people away.
HAD-1226.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1226.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1227.text: The one who calls to right guidance receives the reward of those who follow him.
HAD-1227.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1227.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1228.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1228.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1229.text: Deeds are only according to intentions.
HAD-1229.narrator: ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1229.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1230.text: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not wrong him and does not hand him over.
HAD-1230.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1230.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1231.text: Whoever does not show mercy to people is not shown mercy.
HAD-1231.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1231.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1232.text: Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
HAD-1232.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1232.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1233.text: The believer is to the believer like a building; one part strengthens the other.
HAD-1233.narrator: Abū Mūsā رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1233.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1234.text: Whoever takes a path to knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1234.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1234.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1235.text: Allah loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-1235.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1236.text: The believer is not the one who often censures, curses, or speaks indecently.
HAD-1236.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1236.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1237.text: The All-Merciful shows mercy to the merciful.
HAD-1237.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1237.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1238.text: Whoever bears a weapon against us is not of us.
HAD-1238.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1238.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1239.text: Make use of five before five: your youth before your old age.
HAD-1239.narrator: Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1239.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1240.text: The world is the prison of the believer and the paradise of the disbeliever.
HAD-1240.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1240.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1241.text: Whoever goes astray after right guidance has no excuse, because he abandoned it.
HAD-1241.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1241.speaker: He said:

HAD-1242.text: The community is what accords with the truth, even if you are alone.
HAD-1242.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1242.speaker: He said:

HAD-1243.text: O son of Ādam, you are only days; when a day passes, a part of you passes.
HAD-1243.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1243.speaker: He said:

HAD-1244.text: The Sunnah is like the ark of Nūḥ; whoever boards it is saved.
HAD-1244.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1244.speaker: He said:

HAD-1245.text: Do not speak in any matter in which you have no Imām before you.
HAD-1245.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1245.speaker: He said:

HAD-1666.text: Allah does not look at your bodies and does not look at your forms, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
HAD-1666.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1666.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1667.text: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in both there is good.
HAD-1667.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1667.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1668.text: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.
HAD-1668.narrator: Ḥakīm ibn Ḥizām رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1668.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1669.text: Whoever points to something good receives the same reward as the one who does it.
HAD-1669.narrator: Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1669.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1670.text: The believer is to the believer like a building; one part of it strengthens the other.
HAD-1670.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1670.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1671.text: Truthfulness is trust, and lying is betrayal.
HAD-1671.narrator: Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1671.speaker: He said:

HAD-1672.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.
HAD-1672.narrator: ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1672.speaker: He said:

HAD-1673.text: If our hearts were pure, they would never be sated with the word of Allah.
HAD-1673.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1673.speaker: He said:

HAD-1674.text: The world is moving away, and the Hereafter is drawing near; be children of the Hereafter and not children of the world.
HAD-1674.narrator: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1674.speaker: He said:

HAD-1675.text: The believer sees his sins as if he were sitting under a mountain and feared that it would fall upon him.
HAD-1675.narrator: Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1675.speaker: He said:

HAD-1676.text: A good deed brings light in the face, light in the heart, spaciousness in provision, and love in the hearts of creatures.
HAD-1676.narrator: Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1676.speaker: He said:

HAD-1677.text: When you reach the evening, do not expect the morning; and when you reach the morning, do not expect the evening.
HAD-1677.narrator: Ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1677.speaker: He said:

HAD-1678.text: Learn knowledge, for learning it out of fear of Allah is humility.
HAD-1678.narrator: Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1678.speaker: He said:

HAD-1679.text: It belongs to a person’s understanding that he sets his needs in order so that he can devote himself to his prayer.
HAD-1679.narrator: Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1679.speaker: He said:

HAD-1680.text: A house in which the Qurʾān is read becomes spacious for its inhabitants and is visited by the angels.
HAD-1680.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1680.speaker: He said:

HAD-1681.text: The character of the Prophet ﷺ was the Qurʾān.
HAD-1681.speaker: She said:

HAD-1682.text: Follow and do not invent anew, for you have already been sufficed.
HAD-1682.narrator: Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1682.speaker: He said:

HAD-1683.text: Every ʿIbādah that the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ did not perform, do not perform it.
HAD-1683.narrator: Ḥuḏayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1683.speaker: He said:

HAD-1684.text: Do not be like someone who admonishes others and forgets himself.
HAD-1684.narrator: Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1684.speaker: He said:

HAD-1685.text: Sit with those who repent, for they possess the softest hearts.
HAD-1685.narrator: ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1685.speaker: He said:

HAD-1606.text: Perhaps a small deed grows through the intention, and perhaps a great deed becomes small through the intention.
HAD-1606.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1606.speaker: He said:

HAD-1607.text: Follow the paths of right guidance; the small number of their people does not harm you.
HAD-1607.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1607.speaker: He said:

HAD-1608.text: Whoever loves an innovator, Allah nullifies his deed and removes the light of Islām from his heart.
HAD-1608.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1608.speaker: He said:

HAD-1609.text: They used to hate that someone tests his brother with dispute and debate.
HAD-1609.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibrāhīm an-Naḫaʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1609.speaker: He said:

HAD-1610.text: Among the signs of the Sunnah is that a person guards his tongue from dispute.
HAD-1610.narrator: It is transmitted from Ṭāwūs ibn Kaysān رحمه الله:
HAD-1610.speaker: He said:

HAD-1611.text: Be in this world like a stranger or like a passer-by.
HAD-1611.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1611.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1612.text: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not wrong him and does not hand him over.
HAD-1612.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1612.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1613.text: Whoever covers the faults of a Muslim, Allah covers his faults on the Day of Resurrection.
HAD-1613.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1613.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1614.text: Whoever travels a path on which he seeks knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1614.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1614.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1615.text: Whoever calls to right guidance receives a reward like the rewards of those who follow him.
HAD-1615.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1615.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1616.text: Whoever calls to misguidance bears a sin like the sins of those who follow him.
HAD-1616.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1616.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1617.text: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
HAD-1617.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1617.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1618.text: The believer is not bitten twice from the same hole.
HAD-1618.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1618.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1619.text: The religion is easy, and no one goes to excess in the religion except that it overcomes him.
HAD-1619.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1619.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1620.text: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most constant ones, even if they are few.
HAD-1620.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1621.text: Every good deed is a Ṣadaqah.
HAD-1621.narrator: Ǧābir ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1621.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1622.text: Do not belittle anything of the good, even if you meet your brother with a kindly face.
HAD-1622.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1622.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1623.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1623.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1624.text: A smile into the face of your brother is a Ṣadaqah for you.
HAD-1624.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1624.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1625.text: Make things easy and do not make them hard; give glad tidings and do not frighten away.
HAD-1625.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1625.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1706.text: The testing of people is by the Ḥadīṯ; whoever honors the Ḥadīṯ, his religion is strong.
HAD-1706.narrator: ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī رحمه الله said:
HAD-1706.speaker: He said:

HAD-1707.text: Know that Islam is the Sunnah and the Sunnah is Islam.
HAD-1707.speaker: He said:

HAD-1708.text: Whoever leaves the path of the believers, Allah lets him follow what he himself has turned to.
HAD-1708.speaker: He said:

HAD-1709.text: Salvation lies in following the Sunnah and in eating what is lawful.
HAD-1709.narrator: Sahl ibn ʿAbdillāh at-Tustarī رحمه الله said:
HAD-1709.speaker: He said:

HAD-1710.text: Be patient upon the Sunnah; stop where the people stopped, and speak with that with which they spoke.
HAD-1710.speaker: He said:

HAD-1711.text: Allah accepts nothing except what is pure.
HAD-1711.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1711.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1712.text: The traveler who raises his hands to the sky and says: O Lord, O Lord — yet his food is forbidden; how should he be answered?
HAD-1712.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1712.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1713.text: The lawful is clear and the forbidden is clear; between them lie doubtful matters that many people do not know.
HAD-1713.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1713.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1714.text: Whoever relieves a believer of a worry in this world, Allah relieves him of a worry from the Day of Resurrection.
HAD-1714.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1714.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1715.text: The Most Merciful shows mercy to the merciful; show mercy to those on the earth, then the One above the heaven will show mercy to you.
HAD-1715.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1715.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1716.text: Whoever is not merciful, mercy is not shown to him.
HAD-1716.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1716.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1717.text: Make things easy and do not make them hard; bring glad tidings and do not drive people away.
HAD-1717.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1717.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1718.text: Whoever is not merciful to people, Allah is not merciful to him.
HAD-1718.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1718.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1719.text: Whoever provides for an orphan that belongs to him or to someone else will be with me in Paradise like these two — and he pointed to two fingers.
HAD-1719.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1719.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1720.text: I and the one who cares for an orphan are in Paradise like these two.
HAD-1720.narrator: Sahl ibn Saʿd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1720.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1721.text: The one who provides for a widow and a needy person is like the fighter on the path of Allah or like the one who prays at night and fasts during the day.
HAD-1721.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1721.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1722.text: The strong one is not the one who throws people down, but the one who controls himself when angry.
HAD-1722.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1722.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1723.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1723.speaker: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: Give me advice. He said:

HAD-1724.text: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
HAD-1724.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1724.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1725.text: A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim; he does not oppress him, does not abandon him, and does not despise him.
HAD-1725.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1725.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1726.text: It is enough evil for a person that he despises his Muslim brother.
HAD-1726.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1726.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1727.text: Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captive.
HAD-1727.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1727.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1728.text: To visit the sick, to follow the funeral procession, to respond to the one who sneezes, to support the weak, and to help the oppressed.
HAD-1728.narrator: al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1728.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ commanded us:

HAD-1729.text: The rights of the Muslim upon the Muslim are six: among them the greeting of peace, accepting the invitation, and visiting the sick.
HAD-1729.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1729.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1730.text: Whoever visits a sick person remains in a harvest of Paradise until he returns.
HAD-1730.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1731.text: The servant is nearest to his Lord when he is prostrating; so increase the Duʿāʾ in it.
HAD-1731.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1731.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1732.text: The two Rakʿah before the dawn prayer are better than the world and all that is in it.
HAD-1732.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1733.text: Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, for him Allah builds something like it in Paradise.
HAD-1733.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1733.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1734.text: When the evening meal is served and the prayer begins, then begin with the evening meal.
HAD-1734.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1734.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1735.text: The Imām was appointed so that he would be followed.
HAD-1735.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1735.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1736.text: Whoever performs the dawn prayer is under the protection of Allah.
HAD-1736.narrator: Ǧundub ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1736.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1737.text: From one ʿUmrah to the next there is expiation for what lies between them; and for an accepted Ḥaǧǧ there is no reward except Paradise.
HAD-1737.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1737.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1738.text: The angels supplicate for one of you as long as he remains at his place of prayer: O Allah, forgive him; O Allah, have mercy on him — so long as he does not break his Wuḍūʾ.
HAD-1738.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1738.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1739.text: When one of you enters the mosque, he should not sit until he has prayed two Rakʿah.
HAD-1739.narrator: Abū Qatādah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1739.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1740.text: The five prayers, and from one Friday prayer to the next, are an expiation for what lies between them, so long as the major sins are avoided.
HAD-1740.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1740.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1741.text: The believer sees his sins as though he were sitting beneath a mountain and feared that it would fall upon him; the wicked one sees his sins like a fly that passes by his nose.
HAD-1741.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1741.speaker: He said:

HAD-1742.text: When you reach the evening, do not expect the morning; and when you reach the morning, do not expect the evening. Take from your health for your illness and from your life for your death.
HAD-1742.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1742.speaker: He said:

HAD-1743.text: How excellent are the women of the Anṣār: their modesty did not prevent them from educating themselves in the Dīn.
HAD-1743.speaker: She said:

HAD-1744.text: I have preserved from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ two vessels of knowledge: one of them I have spread; if I were to spread the other, this throat would be cut.
HAD-1744.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1744.speaker: He said:

HAD-1745.text: Whoever worshipped Muḥammad ﷺ: Muḥammad ﷺ has died. But whoever worships Allah: Allah is living and does not die.
HAD-1745.narrator: Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1745.speaker: He said:

HAD-1906.text: Whoever introduces an innovation in Islam and considers it good thereby claims that Muḥammad ﷺ betrayed the message. What was not religion then is not religion today either.
HAD-1906.narrator: Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله said:
HAD-1906.speaker: He said:

HAD-1907.text: I see death today as an honor for every Muslim who meets Allah upon the Sunnah. We complain to Allah about the disappearance of the scholars and the people of the Sunnah and the appearance of innovations.
HAD-1907.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله said:
HAD-1907.speaker: He said:

HAD-1908.text: If you hear a man attacking the narrations or rejecting them, and he wants something other than the narrations, then recognize in that a sign of inclination and innovation.
HAD-1908.speaker: He said:

HAD-1909.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are: holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were, following them, and abandoning innovations.
HAD-1909.narrator: Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله said:
HAD-1909.speaker: He said:

HAD-1910.text: Hold to the narration and the way of the Salaf and beware of every newly introduced matter, for it is an innovation.
HAD-1910.speaker: He said:

HAD-1911.text: The believer is to the believer like a building: one part strengthens the other.
HAD-1911.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1911.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1912.text: Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
HAD-1912.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1912.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1913.text: Whoever covers a Muslim, Allah covers him in this world and in the Hereafter.
HAD-1913.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1913.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1914.text: Ǧibrīl did not cease to enjoin the neighbor upon me until I thought he would make him an heir.
HAD-1914.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1914.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1915.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent, honor his neighbor, and honor his guest.
HAD-1915.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1915.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1916.text: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I direct you to something by which you will love one another? Spread the Salām among you.
HAD-1916.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1916.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1917.text: The best Islamic conduct is: to give food and to give the Salām to the one you know and the one you do not know.
HAD-1917.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1917.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1918.text: A person will be with the one he loves.
HAD-1918.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1918.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1919.text: Allah says: O My servants, I have forbidden injustice to Myself and I have also forbidden it among you; so do not commit injustice against one another.
HAD-1919.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1919.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1920.text: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most untrue speech.
HAD-1920.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1920.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1921.text: Whoever deceives us is not of us.
HAD-1921.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1921.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1922.narrator: Tamīm ad-Dārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1922.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1923.text: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-1923.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1924.text: Gentleness is in nothing without adorning it, and it is removed from nothing without marring it.
HAD-1924.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1925.text: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in both there is good. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not be incapable.
HAD-1925.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1925.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1526.text: Pay attention to what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not be incapable.
HAD-1526.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1526.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1527.text: A person utters a word without considering its gravity, and thereby falls into the Fire.
HAD-1527.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1527.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1528.text: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
HAD-1528.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1528.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1529.text: Whoever walks the path to the mosque, Allah prepares for him a lodging in Paradise.
HAD-1529.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1529.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1530.text: Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, Allah forgives him.
HAD-1530.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1530.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1531.text: When a person dies, his work is interrupted except through three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who supplicates for him.
HAD-1531.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1531.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1532.text: Whoever introduces into this matter of ours something new that does not belong to it, it is rejected.
HAD-1532.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1533.text: The lawful is clear and the forbidden is clear.
HAD-1533.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1533.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1534.text: A servant utters a word of Allah’s pleasure to which he attaches no importance, and Allah raises him degrees by it.
HAD-1534.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1534.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1535.text: A servant utters a word of Allah’s wrath to which he attaches no importance, and thereby falls into Hell.
HAD-1535.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1535.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1536.text: Patience is at the first shock.
HAD-1536.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1536.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1537.text: Wealth is not an abundance of possessions; rather, wealth is the wealth of the soul.
HAD-1537.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1537.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1538.text: Whoever supplicates for his brother in his absence, the angel says to him: Āmīn, and the same for you.
HAD-1538.narrator: Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1538.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1539.text: Allah revealed to me that you should be humble, so that no one boasts over another.
HAD-1539.narrator: ʿIyāḍ ibn Ḥimār رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1539.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1540.text: Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, Allah forgives him.
HAD-1540.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1540.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1541.text: Stop where the people stopped, for they stopped with knowledge.
HAD-1541.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله:
HAD-1541.speaker: He said:

HAD-1542.text: The end of this Ummah is improved only by that through which its beginning was improved.
HAD-1542.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1542.speaker: He said:

HAD-1543.text: Beware of speaking about a question in which you have no imām.
HAD-1543.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1543.speaker: He said:

HAD-1544.text: The Sunnah is ten; whoever possesses it completely has completed the Sunnah.
HAD-1544.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah رحمه الله:
HAD-1544.speaker: He said:

HAD-1545.text: Whoever knows Allah loves Him; and whoever knows the world renounces it inwardly.
HAD-1545.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1545.speaker: He said:

HAD-1566.text: Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
HAD-1566.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1566.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1567.text: Fear Allah wherever you are, and let a good deed follow the bad deed, one that erases it.
HAD-1567.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1567.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1568.text: Whoever is not merciful is not shown mercy.
HAD-1568.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1568.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1569.text: Whoever is not merciful to people, Allah is not merciful to him.
HAD-1569.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1569.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1570.text: The best among you is the one from whom good is expected and from whose harm one is safe.
HAD-1570.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1570.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1571.text: Truthfulness is amānah, and lying is betrayal.
HAD-1571.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1571.speaker: He said:

HAD-1572.text: Call yourselves to account before you are called to account.
HAD-1572.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1572.speaker: He said:

HAD-1573.text: If our hearts were pure, they would not be sated with the word of Allah.
HAD-1573.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1573.speaker: He said:

HAD-1574.text: The worth of a person lies in the good that he masters.
HAD-1574.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1574.speaker: He said:

HAD-1575.text: Follow and do not invent anew; you have already been sufficed.
HAD-1575.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1575.speaker: He said:

HAD-1576.text: How will you be when a Fitnah covers you, in which the elder grows old and the young one grows up in it?
HAD-1576.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1576.speaker: He said:

HAD-1577.text: Every innovation is misguidance, even if people find it good.
HAD-1577.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1577.speaker: He said:

HAD-1578.text: Do not cast the pearls of wisdom before one who does not understand them.
HAD-1578.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1578.speaker: He said:

HAD-1579.text: Seek knowledge, for learning it for the sake of Allah is fear of Him.
HAD-1579.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1579.speaker: He said:

HAD-1580.text: Learn what you wish; Allah will not reward you until you act upon it.
HAD-1580.narrator: It is transmitted from Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1580.speaker: He said:

HAD-1581.text: You will not be a scholar until you learn; and you will not be one who knows until you act upon it.
HAD-1581.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1581.speaker: He said:

HAD-1582.text: What I fear most is that it will be said to me: You knew; what did you do?
HAD-1582.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1582.speaker: He said:

HAD-1583.text: Every innovation is misguidance, even if people regard it as good.
HAD-1583.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما:
HAD-1583.speaker: He said:

HAD-1584.text: Every act of worship that the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ did not know as worship, do not take it as worship.
HAD-1584.narrator: It is transmitted from Ḥuḏayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1584.speaker: He said:

HAD-1585.text: Fear the places of Fitnah and hold fast to the community.
HAD-1585.narrator: It is transmitted from Ḥuḏayfah ibn al-Yamān رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1585.speaker: He said:

HAD-1646.text: Understanding the hidden defects of the Ḥadīṯ is a knowledge that Allah gives to whom He wills.
HAD-1646.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī رحمه الله:
HAD-1646.speaker: He said:

HAD-1647.text: I have included nothing in my book aṣ-Ṣaḥīḥ except that it is authentic.
HAD-1647.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Buḫārī رحمه الله:
HAD-1647.speaker: He said:

HAD-1648.text: I have not included in this book every authentic report that I know.
HAD-1648.narrator: It is transmitted from Muslim ibn al-Ḥaǧǧāǧ رحمه الله:
HAD-1648.speaker: He said:

HAD-1649.text: If you see a man who belittles the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then know that he is a Zindīq.
HAD-1649.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Zurʿah ar-Rāzī رحمه الله:
HAD-1649.speaker: He said:

HAD-1650.text: Whoever leaves the Sunnah opens for himself the door of desires.
HAD-1650.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Baṭṭah رحمه الله:
HAD-1650.speaker: He said:

HAD-1651.text: There is no permissible envy except in two things: toward someone to whom Allah gave wealth and who spends it for the truth, and toward someone to whom Allah gave wisdom and who judges by it and teaches it.
HAD-1651.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1651.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1652.text: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
HAD-1652.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1652.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1653.text: The religion is easy, and no one goes to excess in the religion except that it overwhelms him.
HAD-1653.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1653.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1654.narrator: Abū Mālik al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1654.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1655.text: Whatever intoxicates in a large amount, a small amount of it is also forbidden.
HAD-1655.narrator: Ǧābir ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1655.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1656.text: The words most beloved to Allah are: Subḥānallāh wa-bi-ḥamdih.
HAD-1656.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1656.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1657.text: Two blessings in which many people suffer loss: health and free time.
HAD-1657.narrator: Ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1657.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1658.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
HAD-1658.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1658.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1659.text: A donation does not diminish wealth.
HAD-1659.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1659.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1660.text: Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow a bad deed with a good one that erases it; and meet people with good character.
HAD-1660.narrator: Abū Ḏarr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1660.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1661.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1661.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1662.text: The best of you is the one who learns the Qurʾān and teaches it.
HAD-1662.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1662.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1663.text: The believer is not stung twice from the same hole.
HAD-1663.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1663.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1664.text: Every good deed is a Ṣadaqah.
HAD-1664.narrator: Ǧābir ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1664.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1665.text: Removing a harmful object from the path is a Ṣadaqah.
HAD-1665.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1665.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1686.text: Whoever enters the grave without provision is like someone who wants to sail the sea without a ship.
HAD-1686.narrator: Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1686.speaker: He said:

HAD-1687.text: Knowledge calls for action; if action answers it, it remains, otherwise it departs.
HAD-1687.narrator: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1687.speaker: He said:

HAD-1688.text: You will not be knowledgeable until you learn; and you will not be knowledgeable through knowledge until you act upon it.
HAD-1688.narrator: Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1688.speaker: He said:

HAD-1689.text: How many people are tested by a praise, and how many are deceived by a covering of their faults.
HAD-1689.narrator: Ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1689.speaker: He said:

HAD-1690.text: The example of the heart and the body is like a king and his soldiers.
HAD-1690.narrator: Salman al-Fārisī رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1690.speaker: He said:

HAD-1691.text: The believer remains concerned about himself until he meets Allah.
HAD-1691.speaker: He said:

HAD-1692.text: This knowledge is religion; so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1692.narrator: Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله said:
HAD-1692.speaker: He said:

HAD-1693.text: The Sunnah is like the ark of Nūḥ: whoever boards it is saved.
HAD-1693.narrator: Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله said:
HAD-1693.speaker: He said:

HAD-1694.text: Treat people as you wish them to treat you.
HAD-1694.speaker: He said:

HAD-1695.text: Hold fast to the narrations of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1695.speaker: He said:

HAD-1696.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are: holding to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were, and following them.
HAD-1696.narrator: Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله said:
HAD-1696.speaker: He said:

HAD-1697.text: Whoever loves a person of innovation, Allah causes his deed to perish.
HAD-1697.narrator: al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله said:
HAD-1697.speaker: He said:

HAD-1698.text: They hated conspicuous clothing and loved humility.
HAD-1698.speaker: He said:

HAD-1699.text: Fear is that you fear Allah so greatly that this fear keeps you from sin.
HAD-1699.narrator: Saʿīd ibn Ǧubayr رحمه الله said:
HAD-1699.speaker: He said:

HAD-1700.text: Part of the Sunnah is to honor the scholars.
HAD-1700.narrator: Ṭāwūs ibn Kaysān رحمه الله said:
HAD-1700.speaker: He said:

HAD-1701.text: Whoever worships Allah without knowledge causes more harm than he sets right.
HAD-1701.narrator: ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz رحمه الله said:
HAD-1701.speaker: He said:

HAD-1702.text: How often a small deed makes the intention great, and how often a great deed makes the intention small.
HAD-1702.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله said:
HAD-1702.speaker: He said:

HAD-1703.text: The believer mixes knowledge with forbearance.
HAD-1703.narrator: Wahb ibn Munabbih رحمه الله said:
HAD-1703.speaker: He said:

HAD-1704.text: The son of Ādam is only a number of days; when a day passes, a part of you passes.
HAD-1704.speaker: He said:

HAD-1705.text: Hope for Paradise without action is a kind of deception.
HAD-1705.speaker: He said:

HAD-1746.text: How can you ask the People of the Scripture about something, while your Book, which was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, is the newest, and you read it unmixed?
HAD-1746.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1746.speaker: He said:

HAD-1747.text: I agreed with my Lord in three things.
HAD-1747.narrator: ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1747.speaker: He said:

HAD-1748.text: Whoever wishes to meet Allah tomorrow as a Muslim should preserve these prayers where the call to them is made, for they belong to the paths of right guidance.
HAD-1748.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1748.speaker: He said:

HAD-1749.text: Whoever tells you that Muḥammad ﷺ concealed something of what Allah revealed to him has lied.
HAD-1749.speaker: She said:

HAD-1750.text: Sit with us, so that we may have an hour of Īmān — that is, remembering Allah.
HAD-1750.narrator: Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1750.speaker: He said:

HAD-1751.text: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
HAD-1751.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1751.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1752.narrator: Tamīm ad-Dārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1752.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1753.narrator: Abū Mālik al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1753.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1754.text: Allah does not look at your forms and your possessions, but at your hearts and deeds.
HAD-1754.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1754.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1755.text: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in both there is good. Strive for what benefits you, seek Allah’s help, and do not become incapable.
HAD-1755.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1755.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1756.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
HAD-1756.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1756.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1757.text: The signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks, he lies; when he promises, he breaks his promise; and when something is entrusted to him, he betrays it.
HAD-1757.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1757.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1758.text: Four qualities — whoever possesses them completely is a pure hypocrite; and whoever possesses one of them bears a trait of hypocrisy until he gives it up.
HAD-1758.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1758.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1759.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1759.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1760.narrator: ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1760.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1761.text: Īmān has more than seventy branches. The highest is the testimony that none is rightfully worshipped except Allah; the lowest is removing something harmful from the path. Modesty, too, is a branch of Īmān.
HAD-1761.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1761.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1762.text: Whoever has in his heart even the weight of a speck of pride will not enter Paradise.
HAD-1762.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1762.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1763.text: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness.
HAD-1763.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1764.text: Gentleness is in nothing without beautifying it, and it is taken from nothing without disfiguring it.
HAD-1764.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1765.text: Whoever is withheld gentleness is withheld good.
HAD-1765.narrator: Ǧarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1765.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1846.text: Do not quarrel with your brother, for quarreling brings forth no good.
HAD-1846.narrator: Ibn Abī Laylā رحمه الله said:
HAD-1846.speaker: He said:

HAD-1847.text: Every fault that I saw in a man I concealed, and I advised him in private.
HAD-1847.narrator: Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn رحمه الله said:
HAD-1847.speaker: He said:

HAD-1848.text: Advise every believer when he asks you about a matter of his religion, and do not withhold sincere counsel from him.
HAD-1848.speaker: He said:

HAD-1849.text: The believer joins good action with fear; the hypocrite joins bad action with security.
HAD-1849.speaker: He said:

HAD-1850.text: Whoever hears of a shameful deed and spreads it is therein like the one who committed it openly.
HAD-1850.narrator: Šubayl ibn ʿAwf al-Aḥmasī رحمه الله said:
HAD-1850.speaker: He said:

HAD-1851.text: The best among you is the one who learns the Qurʾān and teaches it.
HAD-1851.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1851.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1852.text: Whoever recites the Qurʾān masterfully is with the noble, righteous scribes; whoever reads it haltingly and exerts himself in doing so receives two rewards.
HAD-1852.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1853.text: Recite the Qurʾān, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.
HAD-1853.narrator: Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1853.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1854.text: When people gather in a house of Allah, recite the Book of Allah and study it together, tranquility descends upon them, mercy envelops them, angels surround them, and Allah mentions them among those who are with Him.
HAD-1854.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1854.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1855.text: Do not make your houses into graves. The Šayṭān flees from the house in which Sūrat al-Baqarah is recited.
HAD-1855.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1855.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1856.text: Whoever reads the last two verses of Sūrat al-Baqarah in a night, they suffice him.
HAD-1856.narrator: Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1856.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1857.text: Sūrat al-Iḫlāṣ equals a third of the Qurʾān.
HAD-1857.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1857.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1858.text: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: “Glory be to Allah, and to Him praise is due; glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.”
HAD-1858.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1858.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1859.text: Whoever says a hundred times a day, “Glory be to Allah, and to Him praise is due,” his sins are erased, even if they were like the foam of the sea.
HAD-1859.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1859.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1860.text: Whoever says a hundred times a day, “There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him praise is due, and He has power over all things,” receives the reward for freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are written for him, a hundred bad deeds are erased, and he is protected from the Šayṭān on that day.
HAD-1860.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1860.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1861.text: Whoever asks once for blessing upon me, Allah sends blessing upon him ten times.
HAD-1861.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1861.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1862.text: Allah has angels who roam the paths and seek the people of Ḏikr.
HAD-1862.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1862.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1863.text: Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me.
HAD-1863.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1863.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1864.text: The Mufarridūn have gone ahead: the men and women who remember Allah often.
HAD-1864.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1864.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1865.text: Purity is half of Īmān; praise of Allah fills the scale, prayer is light, Ṣadaqah is a proof, patience is radiance, and the Qurʾān is a proof for you or against you.
HAD-1865.narrator: Abū Mālik al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1865.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1626.text: Give glad tidings and do not drive people away; make things easy and do not make them difficult.
HAD-1626.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1626.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1627.text: Allah is kind and loves kindness.
HAD-1627.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1627.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1628.text: The one who strives for a widow and a needy person is like a fighter on the path of Allah.
HAD-1628.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1628.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1629.text: I and the guardian of the orphan are this close in Paradise.
HAD-1629.narrator: Sahl ibn Saʿd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1629.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1630.text: Whoever provides for two girls until they are grown comes with me on the Day of Resurrection like this.
HAD-1630.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1630.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1631.text: Whoever strokes an orphan’s head, only for Allah, has a good deed written for every hair over which his hand passed.
HAD-1631.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1631.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1632.text: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.
HAD-1632.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1632.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1633.text: Lying leads to sinfulness, and sinfulness leads to the Hellfire.
HAD-1633.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1633.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1634.text: Whoever points to good has the same reward as the one who does it.
HAD-1634.narrator: Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1634.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1635.text: The best among you is the one who learns the Qurʾān and teaches it.
HAD-1635.narrator: ʿUṯmān ibn ʿAffān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1635.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1636.text: The likeness of the believer who reads the Qurʾān is like the citrus fruit: its fragrance is good and its taste is good.
HAD-1636.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1636.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1637.text: The one versed in the Qurʾān is with the noble, righteous scribes.
HAD-1637.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1638.text: Read the Qurʾān, for it comes on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its people.
HAD-1638.narrator: Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1638.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1639.text: The Qurʾān and its people are brought on the Day of Resurrection; Sūrat al-Baqarah and Āl ʿImrān go ahead.
HAD-1639.narrator: an-Nawwās ibn Samʿān رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1639.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1640.text: The strong believers are better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believers; in both there is good.
HAD-1640.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1640.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1641.text: O son of Ādam, you are only a number of days; when a day passes, a part of you departs.
HAD-1641.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1641.speaker: He said:

HAD-1642.text: The heart lives through Dhikr and dies through forgetfulness.
HAD-1642.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1642.speaker: He said:

HAD-1643.text: We have greater need of a little Adab than of much knowledge.
HAD-1643.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1643.speaker: He said:

HAD-1644.text: Whoever seeks Ḥadīṯ should hold to truthfulness.
HAD-1644.narrator: It is transmitted from Wakīʿ ibn al-Ǧarrāḥ رحمه الله:
HAD-1644.speaker: He said:

HAD-1645.narrator: It is transmitted from Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1645.speaker: He said:

HAD-1866.text: No people sit together and remember Allah without the angels surrounding them, mercy covering them, tranquility descending upon them, and Allah mentioning them among those who are with Him.
HAD-1866.narrator: Abū Hurayrah and Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1866.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1867.text: Three verses that one of you recites in his prayer are better for him than three large, fat she-camels.
HAD-1867.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1867.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1868.text: Keep the Qurʾān constantly firm, for it slips away faster than camels from their tethers.
HAD-1868.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1868.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1869.text: The words most beloved to Allah are four: “Glory be to Allah,” “all praise belongs to Allah,” “there is none worthy of worship except Allah,” and “Allah is greater.”
HAD-1869.narrator: Samurah ibn Ǧundub رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1869.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1870.text: The likeness of the one who remembers his Lord and of the one who does not remember Him is like that of the living and the dead.
HAD-1870.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1870.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1871.text: Follow and do not invent anything new; you have been given sufficiency.
HAD-1871.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1871.speaker: He said:

HAD-1872.text: Moderation in the Sunnah is better than great effort in an innovation.
HAD-1872.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1872.speaker: He said:

HAD-1873.text: Every innovation is misguidance, even if the people consider it good.
HAD-1873.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1873.speaker: He said:

HAD-1874.text: Beware of what is newly introduced, for what is newly introduced is misguidance.
HAD-1874.narrator: Muʿāḏ ibn Ǧabal رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1874.speaker: He said:

HAD-1875.text: Whoever knows something should say it; whoever does not know it should say: Allah knows it best. For part of knowledge is to say about the unknown: I do not know.
HAD-1875.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1875.speaker: He said:

HAD-1876.text: By Allah, besides Whom there is none worthy of worship: No Sūrah from Allah’s Book was revealed without my knowing where it was revealed, and no verse was revealed without my knowing concerning what it was revealed. If I knew of someone who knows Allah’s Book better and whom camels could reach, I would travel to him.
HAD-1876.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1876.speaker: He said:

HAD-1877.text: I come to you from the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the Muhāǧirūn and the Anṣār. The Qurʾān was sent down upon them, and they know its interpretation better than you.
HAD-1877.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1877.speaker: He said:

HAD-1878.text: Knowledge comes about through learning, and forbearance through the practice of forbearance. Whoever seeks the good is given it; whoever guards himself against evil is protected from it.
HAD-1878.narrator: Abū ad-Dardāʾ رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1878.speaker: He said:

HAD-1879.text: You perform deeds that in your eyes are finer than a hair; we counted them, in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, among the ruinous things.
HAD-1879.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1879.speaker: He said:

HAD-1880.text: When we missed a man at the ʿIšāʾ prayer and at the Faǧr prayer, we held a bad suspicion about him.
HAD-1880.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1880.speaker: He said:

HAD-1881.text: How will it be with you when a Fitnah covers you, in which the old man grows gray and the boy grows up and the people take it as the Sunnah; if something of it is changed, they say: The Sunnah has been changed.
HAD-1881.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1881.speaker: He said:

HAD-1882.text: I will not omit anything that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do; I fear that I will deviate if I abandon something of his way.
HAD-1882.narrator: Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1882.speaker: He said:

HAD-1883.text: We possess no special book except Allah’s Book and this writing; special knowledge is only an understanding that Allah gives a person in the Qurʾān.
HAD-1883.narrator: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1883.speaker: He said:

HAD-1884.text: We recognized the end of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ by the audible Takbīr.
HAD-1884.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās رضي الله عنهما said:
HAD-1884.speaker: He said:

HAD-1885.text: The travel prayer is two Rakʿah, the Friday prayer two, the Fiṭr prayer two, and the Aḍḥā prayer two — complete and not shortened, according to the statement of Muḥammad ﷺ.
HAD-1885.narrator: ʿUmar ibn al-Ḫaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه said:
HAD-1885.speaker: He said:

HAD-1546.text: They used not to ask about the Isnād; when the Fitnah came, they said: Name your men to us.
HAD-1546.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1546.speaker: He said:

HAD-1547.text: The most perfect deed is the most sincere and the most correct.
HAD-1547.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله:
HAD-1547.speaker: He said:

HAD-1548.text: I have never discussed with anyone except that I wanted Allah to make the truth appear on his tongue.
HAD-1548.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1548.speaker: He said:

HAD-1549.text: A sign of the people of innovation is reviling the people of the Āṯār.
HAD-1549.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī رحمه الله:
HAD-1549.speaker: He said:

HAD-1550.text: Know that the foundation of the religion is holding fast to the Sunnah and abandoning innovation.
HAD-1550.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Baṭṭah رحمه الله:
HAD-1550.speaker: He said:

HAD-1551.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
HAD-1551.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1551.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1552.text: It belongs to the beauty of a person’s Islām that he leaves what does not concern him.
HAD-1552.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1552.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1553.text: The believer to the believer is like a building whose parts strengthen one another.
HAD-1553.narrator: Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1553.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1554.text: The believers resemble, in their mercy and affection, a body.
HAD-1554.narrator: an-Nuʿmān ibn Bašīr رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1554.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1555.text: The strong one is not the wrestler, but the one who controls himself in anger.
HAD-1555.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1555.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1556.text: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
HAD-1556.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr رضي الله عنهما reported:
HAD-1556.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1557.text: A person is upon the religion of his close friend; so let everyone look at whom he takes as a friend.
HAD-1557.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1557.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1558.text: None of you believes completely until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
HAD-1558.narrator: Anas ibn Mālik رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1558.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1559.text: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most untruthful speech.
HAD-1559.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1559.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1560.text: Allah does not look at your forms and your possessions, but at your hearts and deeds.
HAD-1560.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1560.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1561.text: Allah loves gentleness in all matters.
HAD-1561.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1562.text: Gentleness is not found in anything except that it adorns it; and it is not removed from anything except that it disfigures it.
HAD-1562.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1563.text: Wealth is not the abundance of possessions, but wealth is the wealth of the soul.
HAD-1563.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1563.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1564.text: Whoever strives to be patient, Allah gives him patience.
HAD-1564.narrator: Abū Saʿīd al-Ḫudrī رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1564.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1565.text: Whoever removes a worry from a believer, Allah removes from him a worry of the Day of Resurrection.
HAD-1565.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1565.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:

HAD-1586.text: The likeness of the heart is like a feather that the wind moves in the desert.
HAD-1586.narrator: It is transmitted from Salman al-Fārisī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1586.speaker: He said:

HAD-1587.text: The Qurʾān is for you either a reward or a proof against you.
HAD-1587.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Mūsā al-Ašʿarī رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1587.speaker: He said:

HAD-1588.text: I fear for you the hidden form of Širk: that a person acts for the people.
HAD-1588.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿUbādah ibn aṣ-Ṣāmit رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1588.speaker: He said:

HAD-1589.text: The heart is the king; if the king is good, the soldiers are good.
HAD-1589.narrator: It is transmitted from Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه:
HAD-1589.speaker: He said:

HAD-1590.text: The best woman is the one who fears Allah the most.
HAD-1590.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿĀʾišah رضي الله عنها:
HAD-1590.speaker: She said:

HAD-1591.text: The believer in this world is like a stranger; he does not compete with its people.
HAD-1591.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1591.speaker: He said:

HAD-1592.text: The believer combines Iḥsān and fear; the hypocrite combines wickedness and security.
HAD-1592.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1592.speaker: He said:

HAD-1593.text: This knowledge is religion; so look from whom you take your religion.
HAD-1593.narrator: It is transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1593.speaker: He said:

HAD-1594.text: Formerly they did not ask about the chain of transmission; when the Fitnah arose, they said: Name us your men.
HAD-1594.narrator: It is transmitted from Ibn Sīrīn رحمه الله:
HAD-1594.speaker: He said:

HAD-1595.text: The angels are the guardians of heaven, and the people of Ḥadīṯ are the guardians of the earth.
HAD-1595.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1595.speaker: He said:

HAD-1596.text: Knowledge calls to action; if it answers, it remains, otherwise it goes.
HAD-1596.narrator: It is transmitted from Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī رحمه الله:
HAD-1596.speaker: He said:

HAD-1597.text: Hold to the transmissions of the Salaf, even if the people reject you.
HAD-1597.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1597.speaker: He said:

HAD-1598.text: Be patient upon the Sunnah, and stop where the people stopped; speak with that with which they spoke.
HAD-1598.narrator: It is transmitted from al-Awzāʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1598.speaker: He said:

HAD-1599.text: Nothing will improve the end of this Ummah except that by which its beginning was improved.
HAD-1599.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1599.speaker: He said:

HAD-1600.text: Whoever introduces an innovation into Islām and calls it good claims that Muḥammad ﷺ betrayed the message.
HAD-1600.narrator: It is transmitted from Mālik ibn Anas رحمه الله:
HAD-1600.speaker: He said:

HAD-1601.text: If the Ḥadīṯ is authentic, then it is my school of law.
HAD-1601.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1601.speaker: He said:

HAD-1602.text: All people are, in Fiqh, children of Abū Ḥanīfah.
HAD-1602.narrator: It is transmitted from aš-Šāfiʿī رحمه الله:
HAD-1602.speaker: He said:

HAD-1603.text: The foundations of the Sunnah with us are: holding fast to that upon which the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were.
HAD-1603.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1603.speaker: He said:

HAD-1604.text: Beware of speaking on a matter in which you have no Imām.
HAD-1604.narrator: It is transmitted from Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal رحمه الله:
HAD-1604.speaker: He said:

HAD-1605.text: The chain of transmission belongs to the religion; without an Isnād everyone would say what he wants.
HAD-1605.narrator: It is transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله:
HAD-1605.speaker: He said:

HAD-1806.text: What is correct is to affirm the realities of the attributes that Allah has affirmed for Himself in the Book and in the reports, and at the same time to deny every likeness to the creation.
HAD-1806.narrator: Ibn Ǧarīr aṭ-Ṭabarī رحمه الله said:
HAD-1806.speaker: He said:

HAD-1807.text: Knowledge is what came from the Companions of Muḥammad ﷺ; what did not come from them is not knowledge.
HAD-1807.speaker: He said:

HAD-1808.text: The believer covers, admonishes and advises; the wicked one exposes, shames and spreads.
HAD-1808.narrator: al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ رحمه الله said:
HAD-1808.speaker: He said:

HAD-1809.text: The believer looks for excuses, the hypocrite looks for faults.
HAD-1809.narrator: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mubārak رحمه الله said:
HAD-1809.speaker: He said:

HAD-1810.text: Beware of disputes; they are an hour of a scholar’s ignorance in which the Šayṭān seeks his slip.
HAD-1810.narrator: Muslim ibn Yasār رحمه الله said:
HAD-1810.speaker: He said:

HAD-1811.text: Whoever travels a path on which he seeks knowledge, Allah thereby makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
HAD-1811.narrator: Abū Hurayrah رضي الله عنه reported:
HAD-1811.speaker: The Prophet ﷺ said:
